using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Windows;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using ExcelDataReader;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class ExcelImportService
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString;

        // Результат импорта
        public class ImportResult
        {
            public int TotalRows { get; set; }
            public int SuccessRows { get; set; }
            public int ErrorRows { get; set; }
            public List<string> Errors { get; set; } = new List<string>();
            public List<string> Warnings { get; set; } = new List<string>();
            public List<string> UserCredentials { get; set; } = new List<string>(); // Уже есть
            public bool HasErrors => Errors.Count > 0;
        }
        // Модель данных из Excel
        public class ExcelReaderRow
        {
            public string CardNumber { get; set; }
            public string LastName { get; set; }
            public string FirstName { get; set; }
            public string MiddleName { get; set; }
            public string TypeName { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; }
            public string PostName { get; set; }
            public string Speciality { get; set; }
            public string PhoneNumber { get; set; }
            public string HomeAddress { get; set; }
            public string MembershipStartDate { get; set; }
            public string FormFillDate { get; set; }
            public int RowNumber { get; set; }
        }

        public ExcelImportService(string connectionString)
        {
            _connectionString = connectionString;
        }

        public ImportResult ImportFromFile(string filePath)
        {
            var result = new ImportResult();

            try
            {
                Encoding.RegisterProvider(CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance);

                using (var stream = File.Open(filePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read))
                {
                    IExcelDataReader reader;

                    try
                    {
                        reader = ExcelReaderFactory.CreateReader(stream);
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        return ImportFromCsv(filePath);
                    }

                    using (reader)
                    {
                        var dataSet = reader.AsDataSet(new ExcelDataSetConfiguration()
                        {
                            ConfigureDataTable = _ => new ExcelDataTableConfiguration()
                            {
                                UseHeaderRow = true
                            }
                        });

                        System.Data.DataTable dt = dataSet.Tables[0];

                        if (dt.Rows.Count == 0)
                        {
                            result.Errors.Add("Файл не содержит данных");
                            return result;
                        }

                        ProcessDataTable(dt, result);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                result.Errors.Add($"Ошибка открытия файла: {ex.Message}");
            }

            return result;
        }

        private void ValidateColumns(DataTable dt, ImportResult result)
        {
            var requiredColumns = new[] {
                "Номер читательского билета",
                "Фамилия",
                "Имя",
                "Тип читателя"
            };

            var existingColumns = new List<string>();

            foreach (DataColumn col in dt.Columns)
                existingColumns.Add(col.ColumnName.Trim());

            foreach (var required in requiredColumns)
            {
                bool found = false;
                foreach (var col in existingColumns)
                {
                    if (col.Equals(required, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        col.Replace(" ", "").Equals(required.Replace(" ", ""), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!found)
                {
                    result.Errors.Add($"Не найдена обязательная колонка: {required}");
                }
            }
        }

        private ExcelReaderRow ParseRow(DataRow row, int rowNumber)
        {
            var result = new ExcelReaderRow();

            foreach (DataColumn col in row.Table.Columns)
            {
                string colName = col.ColumnName.Trim().ToLower().Replace(" ", "");
                string value = row[col]?.ToString()?.Trim() ?? "";

                switch (colName)
                {
                    case "номерчитательскогобилета":
                    case "cardnumber":
                        result.CardNumber = value;
                        break;
                    case "фамилия":
                    case "lastname":
                        result.LastName = value;
                        break;
                    case "имя":
                    case "firstname":
                        result.FirstName = value;
                        break;
                    case "отчество":
                    case "middlename":
                        result.MiddleName = value;
                        break;
                    case "типчитателя":
                    case "typename":
                        result.TypeName = value;
                        break;
                    case "группа":
                    case "groupcode":
                        result.GroupCode = value;
                        break;
                    case "должность":
                    case "postname":
                        result.PostName = value;
                        break;
                    case "специальность":
                    case "speciality":
                        result.Speciality = value;
                        break;
                    case "телефон":
                    case "phonenumber":
                        result.PhoneNumber = value;
                        break;
                    case "домашнийадрес":
                    case "адрес":
                    case "homeaddress":
                        result.HomeAddress = value;
                        break;
                    case "датаначалачленства":
                    case "датаначала":
                    case "membershipstartdate":
                        result.MembershipStartDate = value;
                        break;
                    case "датаоформления":
                    case "formfilldate":
                        result.FormFillDate = value;
                        break;
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private bool ValidateRow(ExcelReaderRow row, ImportResult result)
        {
            bool isValid = true;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.CardNumber))
            {
                result.Errors.Add($"Строка {row.RowNumber}: Не указан номер читательского билета");
                isValid = false;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.LastName))
            {
                result.Errors.Add($"Строка {row.RowNumber}: Не указана фамилия");
                isValid = false;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.FirstName))
            {
                result.Errors.Add($"Строка {row.RowNumber}: Не указано имя");
                isValid = false;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.TypeName))
            {
                result.Errors.Add($"Строка {row.RowNumber}: Не указан тип читателя");
                isValid = false;
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.CardNumber))
            {
                if (CheckCardNumberExists(row.CardNumber))
                {
                    result.Warnings.Add($"Строка {row.RowNumber}: Читатель с номером {row.CardNumber} уже существует в базе. Будет пропущен.");
                    isValid = false;
                }
            }

            return isValid;
        }

        private bool CheckCardNumberExists(string cardNumber)
        {
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ReaderForm WHERE CardNumber = @CardNumber", conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CardNumber", cardNumber);
                    int count = (int)cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                    return count > 0;
                }
            }
        }

        private bool CheckLoginExists(string login)
        {
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Users WHERE Login = @Login", conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Login", login);
                    int count = (int)cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                    return count > 0;
                }
            }
        }

        private string GenerateLogin(string lastName, string firstName)
        {
            // Логин = Фамилия + Имя (например: ИвановИван)
            string login = lastName + firstName;

            // Убираем пробелы и лишние символы
            login = login.Replace(" ", "").Replace("-", "");

            // Проверяем уникальность
            string uniqueLogin = login;
            int counter = 1;

            while (CheckLoginExists(uniqueLogin))
            {
                uniqueLogin = login + counter.ToString();
                counter++;
            }

            return uniqueLogin;
        }

        private string GeneratePassword(string cardNumber)
        {
            string password = cardNumber.Trim();

            // Если пароль короче 4 символов, добавляем "lib" в начало
            if (password.Length < 4)
            {
                password = "lib" + password;
            }

            return password;
        }

        private void CreateUserForReader(SqlConnection conn, SqlTransaction transaction, int readerId, string surname, string name, string patronymic, string cardNumber, ExcelReaderRow row, ImportResult result)
        {
            try
            {
                string login = GenerateLogin(surname, name);
                string plainPassword = GeneratePassword(cardNumber);
                string passwordHash = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(plainPassword);

                string query = @"
            INSERT INTO Users (Surname, Name, Patronymic, Login, PasswordHash, ReaderID)
            VALUES (@Surname, @Name, @Patronymic, @Login, @PasswordHash, @ReaderID)";

                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn, transaction)) // Добавлен transaction
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Surname", surname);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Name", name);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Patronymic", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(patronymic) ? (object)DBNull.Value : patronymic);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Login", login);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PasswordHash", passwordHash);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderID", readerId);
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                }

                // Сохраняем данные для входа в результат
                string loginByName = GenerateLogin(surname, name);
                result.UserCredentials.Add($"Читатель {surname} {name} (билет №{cardNumber}): Логин = {loginByName}, Пароль = {plainPassword}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                result.Warnings.Add($"Строка {row.RowNumber}: Читатель добавлен, но ошибка создания учётной записи: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private void ImportReader(ExcelReaderRow row, ImportResult result)
        {
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();

                // Начинаем транзакцию
                using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                {
                    try
                    {
                        bool isStudent = row.TypeName.ToLower().Contains("студент");
                        bool isEmployee = row.TypeName.ToLower().Contains("сотрудник");

                        int typeId = GetReaderTypeId(conn, row.TypeName, transaction);

                        int? groupId = null;
                        if (isStudent && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.GroupCode))
                        {
                            groupId = GetGroupId(conn, row.GroupCode, transaction);
                            if (groupId == null)
                            {
                                result.Warnings.Add($"Строка {row.RowNumber}: Группа '{row.GroupCode}' не найдена. Поле будет пустым.");
                            }
                        }

                        int? postId = null;
                        if (isEmployee && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.PostName))
                        {
                            postId = GetPostId(conn, row.PostName, transaction);
                            if (postId == null)
                            {
                                result.Warnings.Add($"Строка {row.RowNumber}: Должность '{row.PostName}' не найдена. Поле будет пустым.");
                            }
                        }

                        DateTime membershipStartDate = ParseDate(row.MembershipStartDate, DateTime.Today);
                        DateTime formFillDate = ParseDate(row.FormFillDate, DateTime.Today);

                        // Вставка читателя
                        string query = @"
                    INSERT INTO ReaderForm (
                        CardNumber, LastName, FirstName, MiddleName,
                        TypeID, GroupID, Post, Speciality,
                        PhoneNumber, HomeAddress, MembershipStartDate, FormFillDate
                    ) VALUES (
                        @CardNumber, @LastName, @FirstName, @MiddleName,
                        @TypeID, @GroupID, @Post, @Speciality,
                        @PhoneNumber, @HomeAddress, @MembershipStartDate, @FormFillDate
                    );
                    SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY();";

                        int newReaderId = 0;

                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn, transaction))
                        {
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CardNumber", row.CardNumber);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@LastName", row.LastName);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@FirstName", row.FirstName);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@MiddleName", string.IsNullOrEmpty(row.MiddleName) ? DBNull.Value : (object)row.MiddleName);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TypeID", typeId);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", groupId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Post", postId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Speciality", string.IsNullOrEmpty(row.Speciality) ? DBNull.Value : (object)row.Speciality);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PhoneNumber", string.IsNullOrEmpty(row.PhoneNumber) ? DBNull.Value : (object)row.PhoneNumber);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@HomeAddress", string.IsNullOrEmpty(row.HomeAddress) ? DBNull.Value : (object)row.HomeAddress);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@MembershipStartDate", membershipStartDate);
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@FormFillDate", formFillDate);

                            newReaderId = Convert.ToInt32(cmd.ExecuteScalar());
                        }

                        if (newReaderId > 0)
                        {
                            // Создаём учётную запись пользователя - передаём transaction
                            CreateUserForReader(conn, transaction, newReaderId, row.LastName, row.FirstName, row.MiddleName, row.CardNumber, row, result);
                        }

                        transaction.Commit();
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        CustomMessageBox.Show("Ошибка при импорте данных: " + ex.Message);
                        transaction.Rollback();
                        throw;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private int GetReaderTypeId(SqlConnection conn, string typeName, SqlTransaction transaction)
        {
            string query = "SELECT TypeID FROM ReaderType WHERE TypeName = @TypeName";
            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn, transaction))
            {
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TypeName", typeName);
                var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                if (result != null)
                    return Convert.ToInt32(result);
            }

            query = "SELECT TOP 1 TypeID FROM ReaderType WHERE @TypeName LIKE '%' + TypeName + '%' OR TypeName LIKE '%' + @TypeName + '%'";
            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn, transaction))
            {
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TypeName", typeName);
                var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                if (result != null)
                    return Convert.ToInt32(result);
            }

            return 1;
        }

        private int? GetGroupId(SqlConnection conn, string groupCode, SqlTransaction transaction)
        {
            string query = "SELECT GroupID FROM Groups WHERE GroupCode = @GroupCode";
            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn, transaction))
            {
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupCode", groupCode);
                var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                return result != null ? Convert.ToInt32(result) : (int?)null;
            }
        }

        private int? GetPostId(SqlConnection conn, string postName, SqlTransaction transaction)
        {
            string query = "SELECT ID_Post FROM Post WHERE Post_Name = @PostName";
            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn, transaction))
            {
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PostName", postName);
                var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                return result != null ? Convert.ToInt32(result) : (int?)null;
            }
        }

        private DateTime ParseDate(string dateString, DateTime defaultValue)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dateString))
                return defaultValue;

            string[] formats = {
                "dd.MM.yyyy", "dd/MM/yyyy", "dd-MM-yyyy",
                "yyyy-MM-dd", "yyyy/MM/dd", "yyyy.MM.dd",
                "dd.MM.yy", "dd/MM/yy", "dd-MM-yy",
                "d.M.yyyy", "d/M/yyyy"
            };

            foreach (string format in formats)
            {
                if (DateTime.TryParseExact(dateString, format, null, System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles.None, out DateTime result))
                    return result;
            }

            if (DateTime.TryParse(dateString, out DateTime standardResult))
                return standardResult;

            return defaultValue;
        }

        public ImportResult ImportFromCsv(string filePath)
        {
            var result = new ImportResult();

            try
            {
                Encoding.RegisterProvider(CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance);

                using (var reader = new StreamReader(filePath, Encoding.UTF8))
                {
                    string headerLine = reader.ReadLine();
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headerLine))
                    {
                        result.Errors.Add("Файл пуст");
                        return result;
                    }

                    var headers = headerLine.Split(',');
                    var rows = new List<string[]>();

                    string line;
                    while ((line = reader.ReadLine()) != null)
                    {
                        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))
                        {
                            rows.Add(ParseCsvLine(line));
                        }
                    }

                    result.TotalRows = rows.Count;

                    var dt = new System.Data.DataTable();
                    foreach (var header in headers)
                    {
                        dt.Columns.Add(header.Trim());
                    }

                    foreach (var row in rows)
                    {
                        if (row.Length >= headers.Length)
                        {
                            dt.Rows.Add(row);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var paddedRow = new string[headers.Length];
                            Array.Copy(row, paddedRow, row.Length);
                            for (int i = row.Length; i < headers.Length; i++)
                            {
                                paddedRow[i] = "";
                            }
                            dt.Rows.Add(paddedRow);
                        }
                    }

                    ProcessDataTable(dt, result);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                result.Errors.Add($"Ошибка чтения CSV: {ex.Message}");
            }

            return result;
        }

        private string[] ParseCsvLine(string line)
        {
            var result = new List<string>();
            var current = new StringBuilder();
            bool inQuotes = false;

            for (int i = 0; i < line.Length; i++)
            {
                char c = line[i];

                if (c == '"')
                {
                    if (inQuotes && i + 1 < line.Length && line[i + 1] == '"')
                    {
                        current.Append('"');
                        i++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        inQuotes = !inQuotes;
                    }
                }
                else if (c == ',' && !inQuotes)
                {
                    result.Add(current.ToString());
                    current.Clear();
                }
                else
                {
                    current.Append(c);
                }
            }

            result.Add(current.ToString());
            return result.ToArray();
        }

        private void ProcessDataTable(System.Data.DataTable dt, ImportResult result)
        {
            ValidateColumns(dt, result);
            if (result.HasErrors && result.Errors.Count > 0 && dt.Rows.Count == 0) return;

            for (int i = 0; i < dt.Rows.Count; i++)
            {
                try
                {
                    var row = ParseRow(dt.Rows[i], i + 2);
                    row.RowNumber = i + 2;

                    if (ValidateRow(row, result))
                    {
                        ImportReader(row, result);
                        result.SuccessRows++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        result.ErrorRows++;
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    result.ErrorRows++;
                    result.Errors.Add($"Строка {i + 2}: Ошибка обработки - {ex.Message}");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Data;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Converters
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Конвертер для преобразования null или пустой строки в Visibility
    /// </summary>
    public class IsNullOrEmptyToVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            string text = value as string;

            if (parameter != null && parameter.ToString() == "inverse")
            {
                // Обратный режим: пусто = Visible, не пусто = Collapsed
                return string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
            }

            // Прямой режим: не пусто = Visible, пусто = Collapsed
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }
}

using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;

using System.Windows.Documents;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages

    /// <summary>
    /// Логика взаимодействия для AddAuthor.xaml
    /// </summary>
    public partial class AddAuthor : Page
    {
        private string connectionString = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;
        private int? _currentAuthorId = null;
        private System.Collections.ObjectModel.ObservableCollection<object> _allAuthors;

        public AddAuthor()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            LoadAuthors();

            // Маска ввода ФИО
            SurnameAuthorTb.PreviewTextInput += NameField_PreviewTextInput;
            NameAuthorTb.PreviewTextInput += NameField_PreviewTextInput;
            PatronymicAuthorTb.PreviewTextInput += NameField_PreviewTextInput;
            SurnameAuthorTb.PreviewKeyDown += NameField_PreviewKeyDown;
            NameAuthorTb.PreviewKeyDown += NameField_PreviewKeyDown;
            PatronymicAuthorTb.PreviewKeyDown += NameField_PreviewKeyDown;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Загрузка списка авторов из БД
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadAuthors()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = @"
                    SELECT ID_Autor, SurnameAuthor, NameAuthor, PatronymicAuthor
                    FROM Authors 
                    ORDER BY SurnameAuthor";

                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new System.Collections.ObjectModel.ObservableCollection<object>();

                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            items.Add(new
                            {
                                ID_Autor = reader["ID_Autor"] is int id ? id : 0,
                                SurnameAuthor = reader["SurnameAuthor"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                NameAuthor = reader["NameAuthor"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PatronymicAuthor = reader["PatronymicAuthor"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }

                        _allAuthors = items;
                        ApplyAuthorsFilter("");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки авторов: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Фильтрация списка авторов
        /// </summary>
        private void ApplyAuthorsFilter(string searchTerm)
        {
            if (_allAuthors == null)
            {
                LvAuthors.ItemsSource = null;
                return;
            }

            var filtered = _allAuthors
                .Where(item =>
                {
                    var surname = item.GetType().GetProperty("SurnameAuthor")?.GetValue(item)?.ToString() ?? "";
                    var name = item.GetType().GetProperty("NameAuthor")?.GetValue(item)?.ToString() ?? "";
                    var patronymic = item.GetType().GetProperty("PatronymicAuthor")?.GetValue(item)?.ToString() ?? "";

                    return string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm)
                        || surname.IndexOf(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0
                        || name.IndexOf(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0
                        || patronymic.IndexOf(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
                })
                .ToList();

            LvAuthors.ItemsSource = new System.Collections.ObjectModel.ObservableCollection<object>(filtered);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Проверка существования автора в БД
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<bool> IsAuthorExistsAsync(string surname, string name, string patronymic, int? excludeId = null)
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
                    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Authors 
                    WHERE SurnameAuthor = @Surname 
                      AND NameAuthor = @Name 
                      AND (PatronymicAuthor = @Patronymic OR (PatronymicAuthor IS NULL AND @Patronymic IS NULL))";

                if (excludeId.HasValue)
                {
                    query += " AND ID_Autor != @ExcludeId";
                }

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Surname", surname);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Name", name);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Patronymic", string.IsNullOrEmpty(patronymic) ? (object)DBNull.Value : patronymic);

                        if (excludeId.HasValue)
                        {
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ExcludeId", excludeId.Value);
                        }

                        int count = (int)await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync();
                        return count > 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка проверки существования: {ex.Message}");
                return false;
            }
        }

        private void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoadAuthors();
        }

        private void ClearInputFields()
        {
            SurnameAuthorTb.Clear();
            NameAuthorTb.Clear();
            PatronymicAuthorTb.Clear();
            AuthorIDLabel.Content = "";
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Сохранение нового автора (с проверкой на дубликат)
        /// </summary>
        private async void SaveNewRecordButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            string surname = SurnameAuthorTb.Text?.Trim();
            string name = NameAuthorTb.Text?.Trim();
            string patronymic = PatronymicAuthorTb.Text?.Trim();

            // Проверка обязательных полей
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(surname) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Пожалуйста, введите фамилию и имя автора.", "Ошибка ввода",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            // Проверка на существование
            bool exists = await IsAuthorExistsAsync(surname, name, patronymic);
            if (exists)
            {
                string fullName = $"{surname} {name} {(string.IsNullOrEmpty(patronymic) ? "" : patronymic)}";
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Автор \"{fullName}\" уже существует в базе данных.\n\n" +
                    "Пожалуйста, проверьте введённые данные.",
                    "Дубликат записи", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            string query = @"
                INSERT INTO Authors (SurnameAuthor, NameAuthor, PatronymicAuthor)
                VALUES (@Surname, @Name, @Patronymic)";

            try
            {
                using (SqlConnection connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    await connection.OpenAsync();
                    using (SqlCommand command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Surname", surname);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Name", name);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Patronymic", string.IsNullOrEmpty(patronymic) ? (object)DBNull.Value : patronymic);

                        int rowsAffected = await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();

                        if (rowsAffected > 0)
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show($"Автор {surname} {name} {patronymic} успешно сохранён.",
                                "Успешно", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);

                            _currentAuthorId = null;
                            ClearInputFields();
                            LoadAuthors();

                            // Скрываем кнопки редактирования
                            SaveNewRecordButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                            SaveChangesButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                            DeleteButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show("Данные не были сохранены. Проверьте введённые значения.",
                                "Предупреждение", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (SqlException sqlEx)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка базы данных: {sqlEx.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Произошла ошибка: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Сохранение изменений существующего автора (с проверкой на дубликат)
        /// </summary>
        private async void SaveChangesButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!_currentAuthorId.HasValue)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Нет загруженной записи для сохранения. Выберите автора.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            string surname = SurnameAuthorTb.Text?.Trim();
            string name = NameAuthorTb.Text?.Trim();
            string patronymic = PatronymicAuthorTb.Text?.Trim();

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(surname) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Пожалуйста, введите фамилию и имя автора.", "Ошибка ввода",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            // Проверка на существование (исключая текущую запись)
            bool exists = await IsAuthorExistsAsync(surname, name, patronymic, _currentAuthorId.Value);
            if (exists)
            {
                string fullName = $"{surname} {name} {(string.IsNullOrEmpty(patronymic) ? "" : patronymic)}";
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Автор \"{fullName}\" уже существует в базе данных.\n\n" +
                    "Пожалуйста, проверьте введённые данные.",
                    "Дубликат записи", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            string updateQuery = @"
                UPDATE Authors 
                SET SurnameAuthor = @Surname, 
                    NameAuthor = @Name, 
                    PatronymicAuthor = @Patronymic
                WHERE ID_Autor = @Id";

            try
            {
                using (SqlConnection connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    await connection.OpenAsync();
                    using (SqlCommand command = new SqlCommand(updateQuery, connection))
                    {
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Surname", surname);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Name", name);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Patronymic", string.IsNullOrEmpty(patronymic) ? (object)DBNull.Value : patronymic);
                        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Id", _currentAuthorId.Value);

                        int rowsAffected = await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();

                        if (rowsAffected > 0)
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show("Запись успешно обновлена.", "Успешно",
                                CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);

                            LoadAuthors();
                            ClearInputFields();
                            _currentAuthorId = null;

                            SaveNewRecordButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                            SaveChangesButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                            DeleteButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show("Запись не была обновлена. Возможно, она была удалена другим процессом.",
                                "Предупреждение", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                            ClearInputFields();
                            _currentAuthorId = null;
                            SaveNewRecordButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                            SaveChangesButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                            DeleteButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (SqlException sqlEx)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка базы данных при сохранении: {sqlEx.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Произошла ошибка при сохранении: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Удаление автора (с проверкой на связанные записи)
        /// </summary>
        private async void DeleteButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!_currentAuthorId.HasValue)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Нет загруженной записи для удаления. Выберите автора.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            // Проверяем, есть ли книги у этого автора
            bool hasBooks = await CheckAuthorHasBooksAsync(_currentAuthorId.Value);
            if (hasBooks)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Невозможно удалить автора, так как на него ссылаются книги.\n\n" +
                    "Сначала удалите или переназначьте книги этого автора.",
                    "Невозможно удалить", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            var result = CustomMessageBox.Show("Вы уверены, что хотите удалить выбранного автора?",
                "Подтверждение удаления", CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo, CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);

            if (result == CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes)
            {
                string deleteQuery = "DELETE FROM Authors WHERE ID_Autor = @Id";

                try
                {
                    using (SqlConnection connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                    {
                        await connection.OpenAsync();
                        using (SqlCommand command = new SqlCommand(deleteQuery, connection))
                        {
                            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Id", _currentAuthorId.Value);
                            int rowsAffected = await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();

                            if (rowsAffected > 0)
                            {
                                CustomMessageBox.Show("Запись успешно удалена.", "Успешно",
                                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);

                                ClearInputFields();
                                _currentAuthorId = null;
                                LoadAuthors();

                                SaveNewRecordButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                                SaveChangesButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                                DeleteButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                CustomMessageBox.Show("Запись не была удалена. Возможно, она уже была удалена.",
                                    "Предупреждение", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (SqlException sqlEx)
                {
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка базы данных при удалении: {sqlEx.Message}",
                        "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Произошла ошибка при удалении: {ex.Message}",
                        "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Проверка, есть ли у автора книги в библиотеке
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<bool> CheckAuthorHasBooksAsync(int authorId)
        {
            try
            {
                string query = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Books WHERE Author = @AuthorId";
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@AuthorId", authorId);
                        int count = (int)await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync();
                        return count > 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка проверки книг автора: {ex.Message}");
                return false;
            }
        }

        private void ClosePage_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.GoBack();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Двойной клик по списку - загрузка автора для редактирования
        /// </summary>
        private void LvAuthors_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            var item = LvAuthors.SelectedItem;
            if (item == null) return;

            try
            {
                dynamic author = item;
                int authorId = author.ID_Autor;
                string surname = author.SurnameAuthor;
                string name = author.NameAuthor;
                string patronymic = author.PatronymicAuthor;

                SurnameAuthorTb.Text = surname;
                NameAuthorTb.Text = name;
                PatronymicAuthorTb.Text = patronymic;

                _currentAuthorId = authorId;

                SaveNewRecordButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                SaveChangesButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                DeleteButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки автора: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void SearchBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            string term = SearchBox.Text.Trim();
            if (term == "Поиск по фамилии имени отчеству..." || term == "")
                term = "";
            ApplyAuthorsFilter(term);
        }

        private void SearchBox_KeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
            {
                SearchBox.Text = "";
                SearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
            }
        }

        // ========== ВАЛИДАЦИЯ ВВОДА ФИО ==========

        private void NameField_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
        {
            e.Handled = !Regex.IsMatch(e.Text, @"^[a-zA-Zа-яА-ЯёЁ\s\-']$");
        }

        private void NameField_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.V && (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) == ModifierKeys.Control)
            {
                if (Clipboard.ContainsText())
                {
                    string text = Clipboard.GetText();
                    if (!Regex.IsMatch(text, @"^[a-zA-Zа-яА-ЯёЁ\s\-']+$"))
                    {
                        e.Handled = true;
                        CustomMessageBox.Show("Поле ФИО может содержать только буквы, пробелы и дефисы.",
                            "Недопустимые символы", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public class BookListItem
    {
        public int IDBook { get; set; }
        public string InventoryNumber { get; set; } = "";
        public string Title { get; set; } = "";
        public int Year { get; set; }
        public string Price { get; set; } = "";
        public string AuthorName { get; set; } = "";
        public string PublishingHouseName { get; set; } = "";
        public string Category { get; set; } = "";
        public string EditionType { get; set; } = "";

    public partial class AddBook : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;
        private int? _currentIDBook = null;
        private ObservableCollection<BookListItem> _allBooks;
        private CancellationTokenSource _cancellationTokenSource;
        private bool _isLoadingBooks = false;
        private bool _isClosing = false;
        private int _defaultStatusId = 1;

        public AddBook()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            Loaded += OnPageLoaded;
            SubscribeInventoryNumberEvents();
        }

        public AddBook(int IDBook)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _currentIDBook = IDBook;
            SubscribeInventoryNumberEvents();
        }

        private void SubscribeInventoryNumberEvents()
        {
            TbInventoryNumber.PreviewTextInput += TbInventoryNumber_PreviewTextInput;
            TbInventoryNumber.PreviewKeyDown += TbInventoryNumber_PreviewKeyDown;
            TbInventoryNumber.TextChanged += TbInventoryNumber_TextChanged;
            TbInventoryNumber.LostFocus += TbInventoryNumber_LostFocus;
        }

        private async void OnPageLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _isClosing = false;
            ShowBooksLoading(true);
            await Task.Delay(10);
            await LoadDataAsync();

            if (!_currentIDBook.HasValue && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TbInventoryNumber.Text))
            {
                string nextNumber = await GetNextInventoryNumberAsync();
                TbInventoryNumber.Text = nextNumber;
            }
        }

        private void ShowBooksLoading(bool show)
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                if (BooksLoadingPanel != null)
                    BooksLoadingPanel.Visibility = show ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                if (LvBooks != null)
                    LvBooks.Visibility = show ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
            });
        }

        private async Task LoadDataAsync()
        {
            try
            {
            
                var loadTasks = new[]
                {
                   Task.Run(() => LoadAuthors()),           
                   Task.Run(() => LoadPublishers()),       
                   Task.Run(() => LoadGenres()),            
                    Task.Run(() => LoadStatusesFiltered()),  
                    Task.Run(() => LoadReceipts()),          
                    Task.Run(() => LoadEditionTypes()),     
                   Task.Run(() => LoadCategories()),       
                   Task.Run(() => LoadFormats())            
               };
                await Task.WhenAll(loadTasks);
                _cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
                await LoadBooksToListAsync(_cancellationTokenSource.Token);

                if (_currentIDBook.HasValue)
                {
                    await LoadBookDataAsync(_currentIDBook.Value);
                    BtnSaveNew.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                    BtnSaveChanges.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    BtnDelete.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                }
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("Загрузка данных отменена");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                if (!_isClosing)
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                ShowBooksLoading(false);
            }
        }

        //  АВТОГЕНЕРАЦИЯ ИНВЕНТАРНОГО НОМЕРА 
        private async Task<string> GetNextInventoryNumberAsync()
        {
            return await Task.Run(() =>
            {
                try
                {
                    const string query = "SELECT MAX(CAST(InventaryNumber AS INT)) FROM Books WHERE ISNUMERIC(InventaryNumber) = 1";
                    using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                    {
                        conn.Open();
                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                        {
                            var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                            int maxNumber = (result != DBNull.Value) ? Convert.ToInt32(result) : 0;
                            int nextNumber = maxNumber + 1;
                            return nextNumber.ToString("D6");
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch
                {
                    return DateTime.Now.Ticks.ToString().Substring(0, 6);
                }
            });
        }

        //  МАСКА ВВОДА 
        private void TbInventoryNumber_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
        {
            e.Handled = !Regex.IsMatch(e.Text, @"^\d+$");
        }

        private void TbInventoryNumber_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Back || e.Key == Key.Delete || e.Key == Key.Tab ||
                e.Key == Key.Enter || e.Key == Key.Escape || e.Key == Key.Home ||
                e.Key == Key.End || e.Key == Key.Left || e.Key == Key.Right)
                return;
            if (e.Key == Key.Space)
                e.Handled = true;
        }

        private void TbInventoryNumber_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            var textBox = sender as TextBox;
            if (textBox == null) return;
            if (textBox.Text.Length > 6)
            {
                textBox.Text = textBox.Text.Substring(0, 6);
                textBox.CaretIndex = textBox.Text.Length;
            }
        }

        private void TbInventoryNumber_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            var textBox = sender as TextBox;
            if (textBox == null) return;
            string text = textBox.Text.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) return;
            if (!_currentIDBook.HasValue && int.TryParse(text, out int number))
            {
                textBox.Text = number.ToString("D6");
                textBox.CaretIndex = textBox.Text.Length;
            }
        }

        //  МАСКА ВВОДА ДЛЯ ГОДА 
        private void TbYear_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e) => e.Handled = !IsTextNumeric(e.Text);

        private void TbYear_Pasting(object sender, DataObjectPastingEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.DataObject.GetDataPresent(typeof(string)))
            {
                string text = (string)e.DataObject.GetData(typeof(string));
                if (!IsTextNumeric(text)) e.CancelCommand();
            }
            else e.CancelCommand();
        }

        private void TbYear_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            TextBox tb = sender as TextBox;
            string input = tb.Text.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(input)) return;

            if (int.TryParse(input, out int year))
            {
                int currentYear = DateTime.Now.Year;
                if (year > currentYear)
                {
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Год издания не может быть больше текущего ({currentYear}).", "Некорректный год", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                    tb.Text = currentYear.ToString();
                    tb.SelectAll();
                    tb.Focus();
                }
                else if (year < 1000)
                {
                    CustomMessageBox.Show("Год издания должен быть не меньше 1000.", "Некорректный год", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                    tb.Clear();
                    tb.Focus();
                }
            }
            else
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите корректный год (только цифры).", "Ошибка ввода", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                tb.Clear();
                tb.Focus();
            }
        }

        //  МАСКА ВВОДА ДЛЯ ЦЕНЫ 
        private void TbPrice_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
        {
            string text = e.Text;
            TextBox textBox = sender as TextBox;
            string currentText = textBox?.Text ?? "";
            string newText = currentText + text;

            if (!Regex.IsMatch(text, @"^[\d,.]$"))
            {
                e.Handled = true;
                return;
            }

            if ((text == "," || text == ".") && (currentText.Contains(",") || currentText.Contains(".")))
            {
                e.Handled = true;
                return;
            }

            int separatorIndex = currentText.IndexOfAny(new[] { ',', '.' });
            if (separatorIndex >= 0)
            {
                string afterSeparator = currentText.Substring(separatorIndex + 1);
                if (afterSeparator.Length >= 2 && text != "," && text != ".")
                {
                    e.Handled = true;
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        private void TbPrice_Pasting(object sender, DataObjectPastingEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.DataObject.GetDataPresent(typeof(string)))
            {
                string text = (string)e.DataObject.GetData(typeof(string));
                if (!Regex.IsMatch(text, @"^\d+([,.]\d{0,2})?$"))
                    e.CancelCommand();
            }
            else e.CancelCommand();
        }

        private void TbPrice_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            string input = TbPrice.Text?.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(input))
            {
                TbPrice.Text = "";
                return;
            }

            string normalized = input.Replace('.', ',');
            normalized = Regex.Replace(normalized, @"[^\d,]", "");

            int firstComma = normalized.IndexOf(',');
            if (firstComma >= 0)
            {
                string before = normalized.Substring(0, firstComma);
                string after = normalized.Substring(firstComma + 1).Replace(",", "");
                normalized = before + "," + after;
            }

            if (normalized.EndsWith(","))
                normalized = normalized.TrimEnd(',');

            if (decimal.TryParse(normalized, NumberStyles.Any, new CultureInfo("ru-RU"), out decimal value))
            {
                bool hadFraction = normalized.Contains(",");

                if (hadFraction)
                {
                    string[] parts = normalized.Split(',');
                    string fraction = parts[1].PadRight(2, '0');
                    TbPrice.Text = $"{parts[0]},{fraction}";
                }
                else
                {
                    TbPrice.Text = value.ToString("0", new CultureInfo("ru-RU"));
                }
            }
            else
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите корректную цену (например: 700, 700,50 или 700.50)", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                TbPrice.Clear();
            }
        }

        //  ЗАГРУЗКА ДАННЫХ 

        private void LoadStatusesFiltered()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT ID_Status, Title_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status NOT LIKE '%Списана%' AND Title_Status NOT LIKE '%Утрачен%' ORDER BY Title_Status";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(sql, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<object>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int id = reader["ID_Status"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Status"]);
                            string title = reader["Title_Status"].ToString();
                            items.Add(new { ID = id, DisplayStatus = title });
                            if (title.Contains("В наличии"))
                                _defaultStatusId = id;
                        }
                        Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                        {
                            CbStatus.ItemsSource = items;
                            CbStatus.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayStatus";
                            CbStatus.SelectedValuePath = "ID";

                            if (items.Count > 0 && !_currentIDBook.HasValue)
                            {
                                CbStatus.SelectedValue = _defaultStatusId;
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Dispatcher.Invoke(() => CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки статусов: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error));
            }
        }

        private async Task LoadBooksToListAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (_isLoadingBooks) return;
            _isLoadingBooks = true;

            try
            {
                await Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                    const string query = @"
                        SELECT TOP 100
                            b.IDBook,
                            b.InventaryNumber AS InventoryNumber,
                            b.TitleBook AS Title,
                            b.YearPublishing AS Year,
                            b.Price,
                            ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                            ISNULL(p.TitlePublishingHouse, '') AS PublishingHouseName
                        FROM Books b
                        LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                        LEFT JOIN PublishingHouse p ON b.PublishingHouse = p.IDPublishingHouse
                        ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

                    using (var connection = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                    {
                        connection.Open();
                        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                        using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                        using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            var books = new ObservableCollection<BookListItem>();
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                                books.Add(new BookListItem
                                {
                                    IDBook = Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDBook"]),
                                    InventoryNumber = reader["InventoryNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    Title = reader["Title"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    Year = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Year"]),
                                    Price = reader["Price"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDecimal(reader["Price"]).ToString("F2") : "0,00",
                                    AuthorName = reader["AuthorName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    PublishingHouseName = reader["PublishingHouseName"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                                });
                            }
                            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                            {
                                _allBooks = books;
                                LvBooks.ItemsSource = _allBooks;
                                ApplyBookFilter("");
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }, cancellationToken);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                if (!_isClosing)
                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() => CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки книг: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error));
            }
            finally
            {
                _isLoadingBooks = false;
            }
        }

        private void LoadReceipts()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT IDReceipt, ReceiptNumber, ReceiptDate FROM ReceiptBooks ORDER BY ReceiptNumber";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(sql, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<object>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int id = reader["IDReceipt"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDReceipt"]);
                            string date = reader["ReceiptDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReceiptDate"]).ToString("dd.MM.yyyy") : "";
                            items.Add(new { ID = id, DisplayReceipt = $"{reader["ReceiptNumber"]} от {date}" });
                        }
                        Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                        {
                            CbReceipt.ItemsSource = items;
                            CbReceipt.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayReceipt";
                            CbReceipt.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Dispatcher.Invoke(() => CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки актов поступления: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error));
            }
        }

        private void LoadCategories()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT ID_Category, CategoryName FROM BookCategories ORDER BY CategoryName";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(sql, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<object>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            items.Add(new
                            {
                                ID_Category = reader["ID_Category"],
                                CategoryName = reader["CategoryName"].ToString()
                            });
                        }
                        Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                        {
                            CbCategory.ItemsSource = items;
                            CbCategory.DisplayMemberPath = "CategoryName";
                            CbCategory.SelectedValuePath = "ID_Category";
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Dispatcher.Invoke(() => CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки категорий: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error));
            }
        }

        private async Task LoadBookDataAsync(int IDBook)
        {
            await Task.Run(() =>
            {
                try
                {
                    const string query = @"
                        SELECT 
                            b.IDBook, b.InventaryNumber, b.TitleBook, b.Author, b.PublishingHouse,
                            b.YearPublishing, b.Gener, b.StatusBook, b.Price,
                            b.Anotation, b.IDReceip, b.TotalCopies, 
                            b.CategoryID, b.EditionTypeID, b.FormatID
                        FROM Books b WHERE b.IDBook = @IDBook";

                    using (var connection = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                    {
                        connection.Open();
                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                        {
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@IDBook", IDBook);
                            using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                            {
                                if (reader.Read())
                                {
                                    var inventaryNumber = reader["InventaryNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                    var titleBook = reader["TitleBook"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                    var author = reader["Author"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["Author"]) : 0;
                                    var publishingHouse = reader["PublishingHouse"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["PublishingHouse"]) : (int?)null;
                                    var yearPublishing = Convert.ToInt32(reader["YearPublishing"]);
                                    var gener = reader["Gener"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["Gener"]) : (int?)null;
                                    var statusBook = reader["StatusBook"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["StatusBook"]) : (int?)null;
                                    var price = reader["Price"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDecimal(reader["Price"]) : 0;
                                    var anotation = reader["Anotation"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                    var idReceip = reader["IDReceip"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDReceip"]) : (int?)null;
                                    var totalCopies = reader["TotalCopies"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalCopies"]) : 1;
                                    int? categoryId = reader["CategoryID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["CategoryID"]) : (int?)null;
                                    int? editionTypeId = reader["EditionTypeID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["EditionTypeID"]) : (int?)null;
                                    int? formatId = reader["FormatID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["FormatID"]) : (int?)null;

                                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                                    {
                                        TbInventoryNumber.Text = inventaryNumber;
                                        TbTitle.Text = titleBook;
                                        TbYear.Text = yearPublishing.ToString();
                                        TbAnnotation.Text = anotation;
                                        TbPrice.Text = price.ToString("F2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).Replace('.', ',');

                                        CbAuthor.SelectedValue = author;
                                        if (publishingHouse.HasValue) CbPublisher.SelectedValue = publishingHouse.Value;
                                        if (gener.HasValue) CbGenre.SelectedValue = gener.Value;
                                        if (statusBook.HasValue) CbStatus.SelectedValue = statusBook.Value;
                                        if (idReceip.HasValue) CbReceipt.SelectedValue = idReceip.Value;
                                        if (categoryId.HasValue) CbCategory.SelectedValue = categoryId.Value;
                                        if (editionTypeId.HasValue) CbEditionType.SelectedValue = editionTypeId.Value;
                                        if (formatId.HasValue) CbFormat.SelectedValue = formatId.Value;
                                    });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() => CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных книги: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error));
                }
            });
        }

        private void ApplyBookFilter(string searchTerm)
        {
            if (_allBooks == null) return;
            var filtered = _allBooks.Where(book =>
            {
                string title = book.Title ?? "";
                string inv = book.InventoryNumber ?? "";
                string author = book.AuthorName ?? "";
                string publisher = book.PublishingHouseName ?? "";
                return string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm) ||
                       title.IndexOf(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
                       inv.IndexOf(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
                       author.IndexOf(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
                       publisher.IndexOf(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
            }).ToList();
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() => LvBooks.ItemsSource = new ObservableCollection<BookListItem>(filtered));
        }

        private void SearchBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e) => ApplyBookFilter(SearchBox.Text.Trim());

            if (LvBooks.SelectedItem is BookListItem selectedItem)

                _currentIDBook = selectedItem.IDBook;
                await LoadBookDataAsync(_currentIDBook.Value);
                BtnSaveNew.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                BtnSaveChanges.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                BtnDelete.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
        }
