using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class MyBooksPage : Page
    {
        private readonly string _conn = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;
        private readonly ObservableCollection<IssuedBookItem> _myBooks;
        private readonly int _currentReaderId;

        public class IssuedBookItem
        {
            public int Id { get; set; }
            public string IssuanceType { get; set; }
            public string BookTitle { get; set; }
            public string BookAuthor { get; set; }
            public string InventaryNumber { get; set; }
            public string RecipientName { get; set; }
            public DateTime IssuanceDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime PlannedReturnDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime? ActualReturnDate { get; set; }
            public string Status { get; set; }
            public bool IsOverdue { get; set; }
            public int Quantity { get; set; } = 1;
            public string Notes { get; set; }

            public string StatusText
            {
                get
                {
                    if (ActualReturnDate.HasValue)
                        return "Возвращена";
                    else if (IsOverdue)
                        return "Просрочено";
                    else
                        return "В срок";
                }
            }

            public SolidColorBrush StatusColor
            {
                get
                {
                    if (ActualReturnDate.HasValue)
                        return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#28A745"));
                    else if (IsOverdue)
                        return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#DC3545"));
                    else
                        return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#28A745"));
                }
            }
        }

        public MyBooksPage(int readerId)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _currentReaderId = readerId;
            _myBooks = new ObservableCollection<IssuedBookItem>();
            MyBooksDataGrid.ItemsSource = _myBooks;
            this.Loaded += MyBooksPage_Loaded;
        }

        private async void MyBooksPage_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            await LoadDataAsync();
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadDataAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                await LoadMyBooksAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadMyBooksAsync()
        {
            await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(() =>
            {
                Dispatcher.Invoke(() => _myBooks.Clear());

                int totalBooksCount = 0;
                int currentlyHeldCount = 0;
                int overdueCount = 0;
                int returnedCount = 0;

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();

                    // 1. Индивидуальные выдачи
                    LoadIndividualIssuances(conn, ref totalBooksCount, ref currentlyHeldCount, ref overdueCount, ref returnedCount);

                    // 2. Групповые выдачи (группировка по книге внутри выдачи)
                    LoadGroupIssuances(conn, ref totalBooksCount, ref currentlyHeldCount, ref overdueCount, ref returnedCount);

                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                    {
                        TotalIssuedCount.Text = totalBooksCount.ToString();
                        CurrentlyHeldCount.Text = currentlyHeldCount.ToString();
                        OverdueCount.Text = overdueCount.ToString();
                        ReturnedCount.Text = returnedCount.ToString();
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        private void LoadIndividualIssuances(SqlConnection conn, ref int totalBooksCount, ref int currentlyHeldCount, ref int overdueCount, ref int returnedCount)
        {
            string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    bi.IssuanceId AS Id,
                    'individual' AS IssuanceType,
                    b.TitleBook,
                    ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS BookAuthor,
                    b.InventaryNumber,
                    CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(r.MiddleName, '')) AS RecipientName,
                    bi.IssuanceDate,
                    bi.PlannedReturnDate,
                    bi.ReturnDate,
                    bi.Status,
                    bi.Notes,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN bi.ReturnDate IS NULL AND bi.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END AS IsOverdue
                FROM BookIssuance bi
                INNER JOIN Books b ON bi.BookId = b.IDBook
                LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                INNER JOIN ReaderForm r ON bi.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
                WHERE bi.ReaderId = @ReaderId
                ORDER BY bi.IssuanceDate DESC";

            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
            {
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", _currentReaderId);
                using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                {
                    while (reader.Read())
                    {
                        var book = new IssuedBookItem
                        {
                            Id = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Id"]),
                            IssuanceType = reader["IssuanceType"].ToString(),
                            BookTitle = reader["TitleBook"].ToString(),
                            BookAuthor = reader["BookAuthor"].ToString(),
                            InventaryNumber = reader["InventaryNumber"].ToString(),
                            RecipientName = reader["RecipientName"].ToString(),
                            IssuanceDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssuanceDate"]),
                            PlannedReturnDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]),
                            ActualReturnDate = reader["ReturnDate"] == DBNull.Value ? (DateTime?)null : Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReturnDate"]),
                            Status = reader["Status"].ToString(),
                            Notes = reader["Notes"] == DBNull.Value ? "" : reader["Notes"].ToString(),
                            IsOverdue = Convert.ToBoolean(reader["IsOverdue"]),
                            Quantity = 1
                        };

                        Dispatcher.Invoke(() => _myBooks.Add(book));

                        totalBooksCount++;
                        if (book.ActualReturnDate.HasValue)
                            returnedCount++;
                        else if (book.IsOverdue)
                            overdueCount++;
                        else
                            currentlyHeldCount++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Групповые выдачи - группировка по книге внутри выдачи
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadGroupIssuances(SqlConnection conn, ref int totalBooksCount, ref int currentlyHeldCount, ref int overdueCount, ref int returnedCount)
        {
            try
            {
                // Проверяем тип пользователя
                string userTypeSql = "SELECT TypeID FROM ReaderForm WHERE ReaderID = @ReaderId";
                int userTypeId = 1;
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(userTypeSql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", _currentReaderId);
                    var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                    if (result != null)
                        userTypeId = Convert.ToInt32(result);
                }

                // Если не преподаватель, выходим
                if (userTypeId != 3)
                    return;

                string sql = @"
                    SELECT 
                        gi.GroupIssuanceId AS Id,
                        'group' AS IssuanceType,
                        b.TitleBook,
                        ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS BookAuthor,
                        g.GroupCode AS RecipientName,
                        gi.IssuanceDate,
                        gi.PlannedReturnDate,
                        gi.ReturnDate,
                        gi.Status,
                        gi.Notes,
                        CASE 
                            WHEN gi.ReturnDate IS NULL AND gi.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 
                            ELSE 0 
                        END AS IsOverdue,
                        SUM(gii.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity
                    FROM GroupBookIssuance gi
                    INNER JOIN GroupIssuanceItems gii ON gi.GroupIssuanceId = gii.GroupIssuanceId
                    INNER JOIN Books b ON gii.BookId = b.IDBook
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    INNER JOIN Groups g ON gi.GroupId = g.GroupID
                    WHERE gi.TeacherId = @TeacherId
                    GROUP BY 
                        gi.GroupIssuanceId, b.TitleBook, a.SurnameAuthor, a.NameAuthor, a.PatronymicAuthor,
                        g.GroupCode, gi.IssuanceDate, gi.PlannedReturnDate, gi.ReturnDate, gi.Status, gi.Notes
                    ORDER BY gi.IssuanceDate DESC, b.TitleBook";

                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TeacherId", _currentReaderId);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int quantity = reader["TotalQuantity"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalQuantity"]) : 1;

                            var book = new IssuedBookItem
                            {
                                Id = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Id"]),
                                IssuanceType = reader["IssuanceType"].ToString(),
                                BookTitle = reader["TitleBook"].ToString(),
                                BookAuthor = reader["BookAuthor"].ToString(),
                                InventaryNumber = "", // Для групповой выдачи инвентарные номера не показываем
                                RecipientName = $"Группа {reader["RecipientName"].ToString()}",
                                IssuanceDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssuanceDate"]),
                                PlannedReturnDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]),
                                ActualReturnDate = reader["ReturnDate"] == DBNull.Value ? (DateTime?)null : Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReturnDate"]),
                                Status = reader["Status"].ToString(),
                                Notes = reader["Notes"] == DBNull.Value ? "" : reader["Notes"].ToString(),
                                IsOverdue = Convert.ToBoolean(reader["IsOverdue"]),
                                Quantity = quantity
                            };

                            Dispatcher.Invoke(() => _myBooks.Add(book));

                            totalBooksCount += quantity;
                            if (book.ActualReturnDate.HasValue)
                                returnedCount += quantity;
                            else if (book.IsOverdue)
                                overdueCount += quantity;
                            else
                                currentlyHeldCount += quantity;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки групповых выдач: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }
    }
}

using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class MyRequestsPage : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;
        private readonly int _readerId;
        private ObservableCollection<RequestItem> _allRequests;

        // Класс для отображения заявки
        public class RequestItem
        {
            public int ID_Request { get; set; }
            public string RequestNumber { get; set; } = "";
            public DateTime RequestDate { get; set; }
            public string LessonName { get; set; } = "";
            public DateTime LessonDate { get; set; }
            public string StatusName { get; set; } = "";
            public int TotalBooks { get; set; }
            public DateTime? ExpirationDate { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; } = "";
            public int StatusID { get; set; }

            public SolidColorBrush StatusColor
            {
                get
                {
                    switch (StatusName)
                    {
                        case "Новая": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#3498DB"));
                        case "В обработке": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#F39C12"));
                        case "Готова": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#27AE60"));
                        case "Выдана": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#1ABC9C"));
                        case "Отменена": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#E74C3C"));
                        case "Просрочена": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#95A5A6"));
                        default: return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#95A5A6"));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Класс для книг в заявке
        public class RequestBookDetail
        {
            public string BookTitle { get; set; } = "";
            public string AuthorName { get; set; } = "";
            public int Quantity { get; set; }
            public string StatusName { get; set; } = "";
        }

        public MyRequestsPage(int readerId)

        private async void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {

        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadRequests()
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
            SELECT 
                r.ID_Request,
                r.RequestNumber,
                r.RequestDate,
                r.LessonName,
                r.LessonDate,
                ISNULL(rs.StatusName, 'Неизвестно') AS StatusName,
                r.StatusID,
                (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Quantity), 0) FROM RequestItems WHERE RequestID = r.ID_Request) AS TotalBooks,
                r.ExpirationDate,
                g.GroupCode
            FROM BookRequests r
            LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
            LEFT JOIN RequestStatuses rs ON r.StatusID = rs.ID_Status
            WHERE r.UserID = @ReaderId
            ORDER BY r.RequestDate DESC";

                var requests = new ObservableCollection<RequestItem>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", _readerId);
                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                // Безопасное чтение каждого поля с проверкой на DBNull
                                int id_Request = reader["ID_Request"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Request"]) : 0;
                                string requestNumber = reader["RequestNumber"] != DBNull.Value ? reader["RequestNumber"].ToString() : "";
                                DateTime requestDate = reader["RequestDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["RequestDate"]) : DateTime.Now;
                                string lessonName = reader["LessonName"] != DBNull.Value ? reader["LessonName"].ToString() : "";
                                DateTime lessonDate = reader["LessonDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["LessonDate"]) : DateTime.Now;
                                string statusName = reader["StatusName"] != DBNull.Value ? reader["StatusName"].ToString() : "Неизвестно";
                                int statusID = reader["StatusID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["StatusID"]) : 0;
                                int totalBooks = reader["TotalBooks"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalBooks"]) : 0;

                                DateTime? expirationDate = reader["ExpirationDate"] != DBNull.Value
                                    ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ExpirationDate"])
                                    : (DateTime?)null;

                                string groupCode = reader["GroupCode"] != DBNull.Value
                                    ? reader["GroupCode"].ToString()
                                    : "";

                                requests.Add(new RequestItem
                                {
                                    ID_Request = id_Request,
                                    RequestNumber = requestNumber,
                                    RequestDate = requestDate,
                                    LessonName = lessonName,
                                    LessonDate = lessonDate,
                                    StatusName = statusName,
                                    StatusID = statusID,
                                    TotalBooks = totalBooks,
                                    ExpirationDate = expirationDate,
                                    GroupCode = groupCode
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                _allRequests = requests;
                DgRequests.ItemsSource = _allRequests;
                UpdateStatistics();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки заявок: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateStatistics()
        {
            if (_allRequests == null) return;

            int total = _allRequests.Count;
            int active = _allRequests.Count(r => r.StatusName == "Новая" || r.StatusName == "В обработке");
            int ready = _allRequests.Count(r => r.StatusName == "Готова");
            int issued = _allRequests.Count(r => r.StatusName == "Выдана");

            // Можно добавить отображение статистики, если есть элементы в XAML
            // TbTotalCount.Text = total.ToString();
            // TbActiveCount.Text = active.ToString();
            // TbReadyCount.Text = ready.ToString();
            // TbIssuedCount.Text = issued.ToString();
        }

        private void ApplyFilters()
        {
            if (_allRequests == null) return;

            string searchTerm = TbSearch.Text?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "";
            string statusFilter = (CbStatusFilter.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Content?.ToString() ?? "Все заявки";

            var filtered = _allRequests.AsEnumerable();

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm))
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(r =>
                    r.RequestNumber.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    r.LessonName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    r.GroupCode.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm));
            }

            if (statusFilter != "Все заявки")
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(r => r.StatusName == statusFilter);
            }

            DgRequests.ItemsSource = filtered.ToList();
        }

        private void TbSearch_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void CbStatusFilter_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

                await ShowRequestDetails(requestId);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task ShowRequestDetails(int requestId)
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
            SELECT 
                r.RequestNumber,
                r.LessonName,
                r.LessonDate,
                r.RequestDate,
                g.GroupCode,
                rs.StatusName,
                r.ExpirationDate,
                b.TitleBook,
                ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                ri.Quantity,
                ISNULL(ris.StatusName, 'Неизвестен') AS ItemStatusName
            FROM BookRequests r
            LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
            LEFT JOIN RequestStatuses rs ON r.StatusID = rs.ID_Status
            LEFT JOIN RequestItems ri ON r.ID_Request = ri.RequestID
            LEFT JOIN Books b ON ri.BookID = b.IDBook
            LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
            LEFT JOIN RequestItemStatuses ris ON ri.StatusID = ris.ID_Status
            WHERE r.ID_Request = @RequestId";

                var items = new ObservableCollection<RequestBookDetail>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestId", requestId);
                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            bool hasData = false;

                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                if (!hasData)
                                {
                                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                                    {
                                        TbRequestNumber.Text = $"Заявка №: {reader["RequestNumber"]?.ToString() ?? ""}";
                                        TbLessonInfo.Text = $"Занятие: {reader["LessonName"]?.ToString() ?? ""}";
                                        TbRequestDate.Text = reader["RequestDate"] != DBNull.Value
                                            ? $"Дата создания: {Convert.ToDateTime(reader["RequestDate"]):dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm}"
                                            : "";
                                        TbGroupInfo.Text = $"Группа: {reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "Не указана"}";
                                        TbStatus.Text = $"Статус: {reader["StatusName"]?.ToString() ?? "Неизвестно"}";

                                        if (reader["ExpirationDate"] != DBNull.Value)
                                            TbExpirationDate.Text = $"Срок брони: {Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ExpirationDate"]):dd.MM.yyyy}";
                                        else
                                            TbExpirationDate.Text = "";
                                    });
                                    hasData = true;
                                }

                                if (reader["TitleBook"] != DBNull.Value)
                                {
                                    items.Add(new RequestBookDetail
                                    {
                                        BookTitle = reader["TitleBook"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                        AuthorName = reader["AuthorName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                        Quantity = reader["Quantity"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"]) : 0,
                                        StatusName = reader["ItemStatusName"]?.ToString() ?? "Неизвестен"
                                    });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                DgRequestItems.ItemsSource = items;
                DetailsPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;

                if (items.Count == 0)
                {
                    var emptyList = new ObservableCollection<RequestBookDetail>
            {
                new RequestBookDetail
                {
                    BookTitle = "Нет книг в заявке",
                    AuthorName = "",
                    Quantity = 0,
                    StatusName = ""
                }
            };
                    DgRequestItems.ItemsSource = emptyList;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки деталей: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void DgRequests_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DgRequests.SelectedItem is RequestItem selected)
            {
                _ = ShowRequestDetails(selected.ID_Request);
            }
        }
    }

using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Services;
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Navigation;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class NotificationsPage : Page
    {
        private readonly NotificationService _notificationService;
        private ObservableCollection<NotificationDisplayItem> _notifications;
        private bool _isLoading = false;

        public NotificationsPage(NotificationService notificationService)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _notificationService = notificationService;
            _notifications = new ObservableCollection<NotificationDisplayItem>();

            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("?? СТРАНИЦА УВЕДОМЛЕНИЙ ОТКРЫТА");

            // Асинхронная загрузка
            this.Loaded += async (s, e) => await LoadNotificationsAsync();

            _notificationService.NotificationsUpdated += (s, n) =>
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("?? Событие NotificationsUpdated");
                Dispatcher.Invoke(async () => await LoadNotificationsAsync());
            };
            _notificationService.UnreadCountChanged += (s, count) =>
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"?? UnreadCountChanged: {count}");
                Dispatcher.Invoke(() => UpdateUnreadBadge(count));
            };
        }

        private async Task LoadNotificationsAsync()
        {
            if (_isLoading) return;
            _isLoading = true;

            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("?? ЗАГРУЗКА УВЕДОМЛЕНИЙ");

            try
            {
                // Показываем индикатор загрузки
                await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => ShowLoading(true));

                // Загружаем уведомления в фоновом потоке
                await Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    var items = _notificationService.GetNotifications();
                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                    {
                        _notifications.Clear();
                        System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Получено уведомлений из сервиса: {items.Count}");

                        foreach (var item in items)
                        {
                            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"  - ID={item.ID_Notification}: {item.Message}");
                            _notifications.Add(new NotificationDisplayItem(item));
                        }

                        NotificationsList.ItemsSource = _notifications;
                        UpdateUnreadBadge(_notificationService.GetUnreadCount());
                    });
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки: {ex.Message}");
            }
            finally
            {
                await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => ShowLoading(false));
                _isLoading = false;
            }
        }

        private void ShowLoading(bool show)
        {
            if (LoadingOverlay != null)
                LoadingOverlay.Visibility = show ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
            if (MainContentGrid != null)
                MainContentGrid.IsEnabled = !show;
        }

        private void UpdateUnreadBadge(int count)
        {
            UnreadCountText.Text = count.ToString();
            UnreadBadge.Visibility = count > 0 ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        }

        private async void MarkAllReadBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            var result = CustomMessageBox.Show("Отметить все уведомления как прочитанные?",
                "Подтверждение", CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo, CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);

            if (result == CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes)
            {
                try
                {
                    ShowLoading(true);
                    await _notificationService.MarkAllAsReadAsync();
                    await LoadNotificationsAsync();
                }
                finally
                {
                    ShowLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }

        private async void RefreshBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            await LoadNotificationsAsync();
        }

        private void BackBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (NavigationService != null && NavigationService.CanGoBack)
                NavigationService.GoBack();
        }

        private async void Notification_Click(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is FrameworkElement element && element.DataContext is NotificationDisplayItem notification)
            {
                // Отмечаем как прочитанное (асинхронно, без ожидания)
                if (!notification.IsRead)
                {
                    await _notificationService.MarkAsReadAsync(notification.ID_Notification);
                    notification.MarkAsRead();
                    await LoadNotificationsAsync(); // Обновляем список
                }

                // Показываем индикатор загрузки перед навигацией
                ShowLoading(true, "Загрузка страницы...");

                try
                {
                    // Используем Dispatcher с низким приоритетом для навигации
                    await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
                    {
                        NavigationService?.Navigate(new BookRequestsManagement(notification.RequestID));
                    }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Background);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка навигации: {ex.Message}");
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка открытия заявки: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                }
                finally
                {
                    ShowLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }
        private void ShowLoading(bool show, string message = "Загрузка...")
        {
            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
            {
                if (LoadingOverlay != null)
                {
                    if (LoadingText != null)
                        LoadingText.Text = message;
                    LoadingOverlay.Visibility = show ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                }
                if (MainContentGrid != null)
                    MainContentGrid.IsEnabled = !show;
            });
        }
        private async void ViewRequest_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is Button btn && btn.Tag is int requestId)
            {
                ShowLoading(true, "Загрузка заявки...");
                try
                {
                    await Task.Delay(10);
                    NavigationService?.Navigate(new BookRequestsManagement(requestId));
                }
                finally
                {
                    ShowLoading(false);
                }
            }
        }
        private async void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            await RefreshNotifications();
        }

        private async Task RefreshNotifications()
        {
            if (_notificationService != null)
            {
                await _notificationService.CheckNewNotifications();
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("?? Страница уведомлений принудительно обновлена");
                await LoadNotificationsAsync();
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Класс для отображения уведомления с дополнительными свойствами
    /// </summary>
    public class NotificationDisplayItem
    {
        private NotificationService.NotificationItem _source;
        private bool _isRead;

        public NotificationDisplayItem(NotificationService.NotificationItem source)
        {
            _source = source;
            _isRead = source.IsRead;
        }

        public int ID_Notification => _source.ID_Notification;
        public int RequestID => _source.RequestID;
        public string Message => _source.Message;
        public string NotificationType => _source.NotificationType;
        public DateTime CreatedDate => _source.CreatedDate;
        public bool IsRead => _isRead;
        public string RequestNumber => _source.RequestNumber;
        public string FormattedDate => CreatedDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm");

        public string BackgroundColor => IsRead ? "White" : "#E3F2FD";
        public string FontWeight => IsRead ? "Normal" : "Bold";

        public string IconText
        {
            get
            {
                if (NotificationType == "Новая заявка") return "??";
                if (NotificationType == "Готова к выдаче") return "?";
                if (NotificationType == "Просрочена") return "??";
                if (NotificationType == "Отменена") return "?";
                if (NotificationType == "Занятие ПК") return "??";
                return "??";
            }
        }

        public Brush IconColor
        {
            get
            {
                if (NotificationType == "Новая заявка")
                    return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#3498DB"));
                if (NotificationType == "Готова к выдаче")
                    return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#27AE60"));
                if (NotificationType == "Просрочена")
                    return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#E74C3C"));
                return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#3498DB"));
            }
        }
      
        public void MarkAsRead()
        {
            _isRead = true;
        }
    }

using Dadata.Model;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;
using Microsoft.Win32;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class Readers : Page
    {
        private string connectionString = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;
        private ObservableCollection<ReaderDisplayItem> _allReaders;
        private ObservableCollection<ReaderDisplayItem> _filteredReaders;
        private ObservableCollection<ReaderDisplayItem> _searchResults;

        private bool _isSearchProgrammatic = false;


        // Класс для отображения читателя в списке
        public class ReaderDisplayItem
        {
            public int ReaderID { get; set; }
            public string CardNumber { get; set; } = "";
            public string LastName { get; set; } = "";
            public string FirstName { get; set; } = "";
            public string MiddleName { get; set; } = "";
            public int TypeID { get; set; }
            public string TypeName { get; set; } = "";
            public int? GroupID { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; } = "";
            public int? PostID { get; set; }
            public string PostName { get; set; } = "";
            public string Speciality { get; set; } = "";
            public string PhoneNumber { get; set; } = "";
            public string HomeAddress { get; set; } = "";
            public DateTime MembershipStartDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime FormFillDate { get; set; }

            public string FullName => $"{LastName} {FirstName} {MiddleName}".Trim();
            public string Initials => GetInitials();
            public string MembershipDateString => MembershipStartDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy");
            public string GroupOrPostInfo => GetGroupOrPostInfo();

            private string GetInitials()
            {
                string initials = LastName;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(FirstName))
                    initials += $" {FirstName[0]}.";
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(MiddleName))
                    initials += $" {MiddleName[0]}.";
                return initials;
            }

            private string GetGroupOrPostInfo()
            {
                if (TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("студент") == true && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(GroupCode))
                    return $"Группа: {GroupCode}";
                if (TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("сотрудник") == true && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(PostName))
                    return $"Должность: {PostName}";
                return "";
            }
        }

        // Класс для фильтрации по типу
        public class FilterTypeItem
        {
            public int TypeID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayName { get; set; } = "";
        }

        // Класс для фильтрации по группе
        public class FilterGroupItem
        {
            public int GroupID { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; } = "";
        }

        public Readers()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _searchResults = new ObservableCollection<ReaderDisplayItem>();

            // Устанавливаем плейсхолдеры
            SetPlaceholders();
        }

        private void SetPlaceholders()
        {
            SearchBox.Text = "Поиск по фамилии, имени или номеру билета...";
            SearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
            SearchBoxPost.Text = "Поиск по должности...";
            SearchBoxPost.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
        }

        private void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoadFilterData();
            LoadReaders();
        }

        private void LoadFilterData()
        {
            try
            {
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();

                    // Загружаем типы читателей для фильтра
                    var typeQuery = "SELECT TypeID, TypeName FROM ReaderType ORDER BY TypeName";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(typeQuery, connection))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var types = new ObservableCollection<FilterTypeItem>();
                        types.Add(new FilterTypeItem { TypeID = 0, DisplayName = "Все типы" });

                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            types.Add(new FilterTypeItem
                            {
                                TypeID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TypeID"]),
                                DisplayName = reader["TypeName"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }

                        FilterTypeCombo.ItemsSource = types;
                        FilterTypeCombo.SelectedValuePath = "TypeID";
                        FilterTypeCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayName";
                        FilterTypeCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
                    }
                }

                // Загружаем группы для фильтра
                LoadGroupsForFilter();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных для фильтров: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadGroupsForFilter()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = "SELECT GroupID, GroupCode FROM Groups ORDER BY GroupCode";
                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var groups = new ObservableCollection<FilterGroupItem>();
                        groups.Add(new FilterGroupItem { GroupID = 0, GroupCode = "Все группы" });

                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            groups.Add(new FilterGroupItem
                            {
                                GroupID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupID"]),
                                GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }

                        FilterGroupCombo.ItemsSource = groups;
                        FilterGroupCombo.SelectedValuePath = "GroupID";
                        FilterGroupCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "GroupCode";
                        FilterGroupCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки групп: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadReaders()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = @"
                    SELECT 
                        r.ReaderID, r.CardNumber, r.LastName, r.FirstName, r.MiddleName,
                        r.TypeID, rt.TypeName,
                        r.GroupID, g.GroupCode,
                        r.Post, p.Post_Name,
                        r.Speciality, r.PhoneNumber, r.HomeAddress,
                        r.MembershipStartDate, r.FormFillDate
                    FROM ReaderForm r
                    LEFT JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                    LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                    LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
                    ORDER BY r.LastName, r.FirstName";

                using (var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
                {
                    connection.Open();
                    using (var command = new SqlCommand(query, connection))
                    using (var reader = command.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<ReaderDisplayItem>();

                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            items.Add(new ReaderDisplayItem
                            {
                                ReaderID = reader["ReaderID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["ReaderID"]) : 0,
                                CardNumber = reader["CardNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                LastName = reader["LastName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                FirstName = reader["FirstName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                MiddleName = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                TypeID = reader["TypeID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["TypeID"]) : 0,
                                TypeName = reader["TypeName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                GroupID = reader["GroupID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupID"]) : (int?)null,
                                GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PostID = reader["Post"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["Post"]) : (int?)null,
                                PostName = reader["Post_Name"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                Speciality = reader["Speciality"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PhoneNumber = reader["PhoneNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                HomeAddress = reader["HomeAddress"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                MembershipStartDate = reader["MembershipStartDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["MembershipStartDate"]) : DateTime.Now,
                                FormFillDate = reader["FormFillDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["FormFillDate"]) : DateTime.Now
                            });
                        }

                        _allReaders = items;
                        ApplyFilters();
                        UpdateStatistics();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки читателей: {ex.Message}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private IEnumerable<ReaderDisplayItem> GetFilteredReaders()
        {
            if (_allReaders == null) return Enumerable.Empty<ReaderDisplayItem>();

            var filtered = _allReaders.AsEnumerable();

            string searchTerm = SearchBox.Text?.Trim() ?? "";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm) &&
                searchTerm != "Поиск по фамилии, имени или номеру билета...")
            {
                string loweredSearch = searchTerm.ToLower();
                filtered = filtered.Where(r =>
                    r.LastName.ToLower().Contains(loweredSearch) ||
                    r.FirstName.ToLower().Contains(loweredSearch) ||
                    r.FullName.ToLower().Contains(loweredSearch) ||
                    r.CardNumber.ToLower().Contains(loweredSearch));
            }

            string searchPostTerm = SearchBoxPost.Text?.Trim() ?? "";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchPostTerm) &&
                searchPostTerm != "Поиск по должности...")
            {
                string loweredPost = searchPostTerm.ToLower();
                filtered = filtered.Where(r =>
                    (r.PostName?.ToLower().Contains(loweredPost) ?? false));
            }

            if (FilterTypeCombo.SelectedItem is FilterTypeItem selectedType && selectedType.TypeID > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(r => r.TypeID == selectedType.TypeID);
            }

            if (FilterGroupCombo.SelectedItem is FilterGroupItem selectedGroup && selectedGroup.GroupID > 0)
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(r => r.GroupID == selectedGroup.GroupID);
            }

            return filtered;
        }

        private void ApplyFilters()
        {
            _filteredReaders = new ObservableCollection<ReaderDisplayItem>(GetFilteredReaders());
            ReadersListView.ItemsSource = _filteredReaders;

            // Обновляем счетчик результатов поиска
            UpdateSearchCount();
        }

        private void UpdateSearchCount()
        {
            int count = _filteredReaders?.Count ?? 0;
            SearchCountLabel.Text = $"Найдено: {count}";
        }

        private void UpdateStatistics()
        {
            if (_allReaders == null) return;

            TotalReadersCount.Text = _allReaders.Count.ToString();
            StudentsCount.Text = _allReaders.Count(r => r.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("студент") == true).ToString();
            EmployeesCount.Text = _allReaders.Count(r => r.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("сотрудник") == true).ToString();
        }

        // Обработчики SearchBox (ФИО/билет)
        private void SearchBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isSearchProgrammatic) return;

            string searchText = SearchBox.Text.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchText) || searchText == "Поиск по фамилии, имени или номеру билета...")
            {
                SearchResultsList.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                ApplyFilters();  // Показываем всех (фильтр по другим параметрам)
                return;
            }

            ApplyFilters();
            PerformSearch(searchText);
        }

        private void SearchBox_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (SearchBox.Text == "Поиск по фамилии, имени или номеру билета...")
            {
                SearchBox.Text = "";
                SearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
            }
        }

        private void SearchBox_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SearchBox.Text))
            {
                SearchBox.Text = "Поиск по фамилии, имени или номеру билета...";
                SearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
            }
        }

        // Обработчики SearchBoxPost (должность)
        private void SearchBoxPost_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void SearchBoxPost_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (SearchBoxPost.Text == "Поиск по должности...")
            {
                SearchBoxPost.Text = "";
                SearchBoxPost.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
            }
        }

        private void SearchBoxPost_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SearchBoxPost.Text))
            {
                SearchBoxPost.Text = "Поиск по должности...";
                SearchBoxPost.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
            }
        }

        private void FilterCombo_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void ClearFiltersBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            FilterTypeCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterGroupCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            SearchBox.Text = "Поиск по фамилии, имени или номеру билета...";
            SearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
            SearchBoxPost.Text = "Поиск по должности...";
            SearchBoxPost.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
            ApplyFilters();
        }
        private void PerformSearch(string searchText)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchText) ||
                searchText == "Поиск по фамилии, имени или номеру билета...")
            {
                SearchResultsList.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                return;
            }

            _searchResults.Clear();

            var filtered = GetFilteredReaders()
                .Take(10);

            foreach (var item in filtered)
                _searchResults.Add(item);

            SearchResultsList.ItemsSource = _searchResults;
            SearchResultsList.Visibility = _searchResults.Any() ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        }
        private void SearchResultsList_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (SearchResultsList.SelectedItem is ReaderDisplayItem selected)
            {
                _isSearchProgrammatic = true;
                SearchBox.Text = selected.FullName;
                SearchResultsList.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                _isSearchProgrammatic = false;

                // Показываем выбранного читателя вместе с текущими активными фильтрами
                ApplyFilters();

                SearchBox.SelectAll();  // Выделить текст для удобства
            }
        }
        private void SearchBox_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (SearchResultsList.Visibility != Visibility.Visible) return;

            switch (e.Key)
            {
                case Key.Down:
                    if (SearchResultsList.SelectedIndex < SearchResultsList.Items.Count - 1)
                        SearchResultsList.SelectedIndex++;
                    e.Handled = true;
                    break;
                case Key.Up:
                    if (SearchResultsList.SelectedIndex > 0)
                        SearchResultsList.SelectedIndex--;
                    e.Handled = true;
                    break;
                case Key.Enter:
                    if (SearchResultsList.SelectedItem != null)
                    {
                        SearchResultsList_SelectionChanged(null, null);
                        e.Handled = true;
                    }
                    break;
                case Key.Escape:
                    SearchResultsList.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                    e.Handled = true;
                    break;
            }
        }
        private async void ExportReadersBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                ExportReadersBtn.IsEnabled = false;
                ExportReadersBtn.Content = "? Экспорт...";

                var dialog = new SaveFileDialog
                {
                    Filter = "Excel файлы (*.xlsx)|*.xlsx|CSV файлы (*.csv)|*.csv",
                    Title = "Сохранить список читателей",
                    FileName = $"Читатели_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmm}"
                };

                if (dialog.ShowDialog() == true)
                {
                    string filePath = dialog.FileName;
                    string extension = System.IO.Path.GetExtension(filePath).ToLower();

                    var result = await Task.Run(() => ExportReadersToFile(filePath, extension));

                    CustomMessageBox.Show(result, "Экспорт завершен",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK,
                        result.Contains("ошибка") ? CustomMessageBoxImage.Error : CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при экспорте: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                ExportReadersBtn.IsEnabled = true;
                ExportReadersBtn.Content = "?? Экспортировать читателей";
            }
        }

        private string ExportReadersToFile(string filePath, string extension)
        {
            try
            {
                // Получаем данные читателей с логинами и паролями
                var readers = GetReadersWithCredentials();

                if (extension == ".csv")
                {
                    ExportToCsv(readers, filePath);
                }
                else
                {
                    ExportToExcel(readers, filePath);
                }

                return $"Экспорт успешно завершен!\nСохранено: {readers.Count} читателей\nФайл: {filePath}";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return $"Ошибка при экспорте: {ex.Message}";
            }
        }

        private List<ReaderExportModel> GetReadersWithCredentials()
        {
            var readers = new List<ReaderExportModel>();

            string query = @"
        SELECT 
            r.ReaderID,
            r.CardNumber,
            r.LastName,
            r.FirstName,
            r.MiddleName,
            rt.TypeName,
            g.GroupCode,
            p.Post_Name,
            r.Speciality,
            r.PhoneNumber,
            r.HomeAddress,
            r.MembershipStartDate,
            r.FormFillDate,
            u.Login,
            '' AS Password  -- Пароль не хранится в открытом виде, показываем сообщение
        FROM ReaderForm r
        LEFT JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
        LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
        LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
        LEFT JOIN Users u ON r.ReaderID = u.ReaderID
        ORDER BY r.LastName, r.FirstName";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                {
                    while (reader.Read())
                    {
                        var item = new ReaderExportModel
                        {
                            ReaderID = reader["ReaderID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["ReaderID"]) : 0,
                            CardNumber = reader["CardNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            LastName = reader["LastName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            FirstName = reader["FirstName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            MiddleName = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            TypeName = reader["TypeName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            PostName = reader["Post_Name"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            Speciality = reader["Speciality"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            PhoneNumber = reader["PhoneNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            HomeAddress = reader["HomeAddress"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            MembershipStartDate = reader["MembershipStartDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["MembershipStartDate"]) : DateTime.MinValue,
                            FormFillDate = reader["FormFillDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["FormFillDate"]) : DateTime.MinValue,
                            Login = reader["Login"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                            Password = "******"  // Пароль скрыт для безопасности
                        };
                        readers.Add(item);
                    }
                }
            }

            return readers;
        }

        private void ExportToExcel(List<ReaderExportModel> readers, string filePath)
        {
            var excelApp = new Microsoft.Office.Interop.Excel.Application();
            Microsoft.Office.Interop.Excel.Workbook workbook = null;
            Microsoft.Office.Interop.Excel.Worksheet worksheet = null;

            try
            {
                excelApp.Visible = false;
                workbook = excelApp.Workbooks.Add();
                worksheet = workbook.ActiveSheet;
                worksheet.Name = "Читатели";

                // Заголовки
                string[] headers = {
            "ID", "№ билета", "Фамилия", "Имя", "Отчество",
            "Тип читателя", "Группа", "Должность", "Специальность",
            "Телефон", "Адрес", "Дата начала членства", "Дата оформления",
            "Логин", "Пароль"
        };

                for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
                {
                    worksheet.Cells[1, i + 1] = headers[i];
                    var range = (Microsoft.Office.Interop.Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[1, i + 1];
                    range.Font.Bold = true;
                    range.Interior.Color = System.Drawing.Color.LightGray.ToArgb();
                }

                // Данные
                int row = 2;
                foreach (var r in readers)
                {
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 1] = r.ReaderID;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 2] = r.CardNumber;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 3] = r.LastName;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 4] = r.FirstName;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 5] = r.MiddleName;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 6] = r.TypeName;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 7] = r.GroupCode;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 8] = r.PostName;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 9] = r.Speciality;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 10] = r.PhoneNumber;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 11] = r.HomeAddress;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 12] = r.MembershipStartDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy");
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 13] = r.FormFillDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy");
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 14] = r.Login;
                    worksheet.Cells[row, 15] = r.Password;
                    row++;
                }

                worksheet.Columns.AutoFit();
                workbook.SaveAs(filePath, Microsoft.Office.Interop.Excel.XlFileFormat.xlOpenXMLWorkbook);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (worksheet != null) System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(worksheet);
                if (workbook != null)
                {
                    workbook.Close(false);
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(workbook);
                }
                if (excelApp != null)
                {
                    excelApp.Quit();
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(excelApp);
                }
            }
        }

        private void ExportToCsv(List<ReaderExportModel> readers, string filePath)
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder();

            // Заголовки
            sb.AppendLine("ID;Номер билета;Фамилия;Имя;Отчество;Тип читателя;Группа;Должность;Специальность;Телефон;Адрес;Дата начала членства;Дата оформления;Логин;Пароль");

            // Данные
            foreach (var r in readers)
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"{r.ReaderID};{EscapeCsv(r.CardNumber)};{EscapeCsv(r.LastName)};{EscapeCsv(r.FirstName)};{EscapeCsv(r.MiddleName)};{EscapeCsv(r.TypeName)};{EscapeCsv(r.GroupCode)};{EscapeCsv(r.PostName)};{EscapeCsv(r.Speciality)};{EscapeCsv(r.PhoneNumber)};{EscapeCsv(r.HomeAddress)};{r.MembershipStartDate:dd.MM.yyyy};{r.FormFillDate:dd.MM.yyyy};{EscapeCsv(r.Login)};{EscapeCsv(r.Password)}");
            }

            File.WriteAllText(filePath, sb.ToString(), Encoding.UTF8);
        }

        private string EscapeCsv(string value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) return "";
            // Экранируем точку с запятой и кавычки
            if (value.Contains(";") || value.Contains("\""))
            {
                value = value.Replace("\"", "\"\"");
                return $"\"{value}\"";
            }
            return value;
        }

    public partial class ReportsPage : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;
        private bool _isLoading = false;

        public ReportsPage()
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            // Устанавливаем значения по умолчанию
            StartDatePicker.SelectedDate = new DateTime(DateTime.Now.Year, DateTime.Now.Month, 1);
            EndDatePicker.SelectedDate = DateTime.Now.Date;

            // Подписываемся на события изменения дат (если ещё не сделано)
            StartDatePicker.SelectedDateChanged += StartDatePicker_SelectedDateChanged;
            EndDatePicker.SelectedDateChanged += EndDatePicker_SelectedDateChanged;
        }

        // ========== ПРОВЕРКА ДАТ ==========

        private bool ValidateDates()
        {
            if (StartDatePicker.SelectedDate == null || EndDatePicker.SelectedDate == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Пожалуйста, выберите обе даты (с и по).", "Ошибка ввода",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            DateTime start = StartDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value.Date;
            DateTime end = EndDatePicker.SelectedDate.Value.Date;

            if (start > end)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Дата 'с' не может быть позже даты 'по'.", "Ошибка ввода",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);

                // Опционально: автоматически корректируем, если пользователь ошибся
                EndDatePicker.SelectedDate = start;
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        private async Task<ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceReport>> LoadBookIssuanceReportAsync(DateTime start, DateTime end)
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceReport>();

            string query = @"
        -- Индивидуальные выдачи
        SELECT 
            i.IssuanceDate,
            b.TitleBook,
            b.InventaryNumber,
            CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(r.MiddleName, '')) AS ReaderName,
            CASE 
                WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Студент' THEN ISNULL(g.GroupCode, '')
                WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Сотрудник' THEN ISNULL(p.Post_Name, '')
                ELSE ''
            END AS GroupOrPost,
            i.PlannedReturnDate,
            i.ReturnDate,
            i.Status,
            CASE 
                WHEN i.ReturnDate IS NULL AND i.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() 
                THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, i.PlannedReturnDate, GETDATE())
                WHEN i.ReturnDate > i.PlannedReturnDate
                THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, i.PlannedReturnDate, i.ReturnDate)
                ELSE 0
            END AS DaysOverdue,
            'Индивидуальная' AS IssuanceType
        FROM BookIssuance i
        INNER JOIN Books b ON i.BookId = b.IDBook
        INNER JOIN ReaderForm r ON i.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
        INNER JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
        LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
        LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
        WHERE CAST(i.IssuanceDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- Групповые выдачи (детализированные по книгам)
        SELECT 
            gi.IssuanceDate,
            b.TitleBook,
            b.InventaryNumber,
            CONCAT(t.LastName, ' ', t.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(t.MiddleName, '')) + ' (преподаватель)' AS ReaderName,
            g.GroupCode AS GroupOrPost,
            gi.PlannedReturnDate,
            gi.ReturnDate,
            gi.Status,
            CASE 
                WHEN gi.ReturnDate IS NULL AND gi.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() 
                THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, gi.PlannedReturnDate, GETDATE())
                WHEN gi.ReturnDate > gi.PlannedReturnDate
                THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, gi.PlannedReturnDate, gi.ReturnDate)
                ELSE 0
            END AS DaysOverdue,
            'Групповая' AS IssuanceType
        FROM GroupBookIssuance gi
        INNER JOIN Groups g ON gi.GroupId = g.GroupID
        INNER JOIN GroupIssuanceItems gii ON gi.GroupIssuanceId = gii.GroupIssuanceId
        INNER JOIN Books b ON gii.BookId = b.IDBook
        LEFT JOIN ReaderForm t ON gi.TeacherId = t.ReaderID
        WHERE CAST(gi.IssuanceDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        
        ORDER BY IssuanceDate DESC";

            using (SqlConnection conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync();
                using (SqlCommand cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StartDate", start.Date);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EndDate", end.Date);

                    using (SqlDataReader reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                    {
                        while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                        {
                            var report = new BookIssuanceReport
                            {
                                IssuanceDate = reader.GetDateTime(0),
                                BookTitle = reader.GetString(1),
                                InventoryNumber = reader.GetString(2),
                                ReaderName = reader.GetString(3),
                                GroupOrPost = reader.GetString(4),
                                PlannedReturnDate = reader.GetDateTime(5),
                                ReturnDate = reader.IsDBNull(6) ? (DateTime?)null : reader.GetDateTime(6),
                                Status = reader.GetString(7),
                                DaysOverdue = reader.GetInt32(8),
                                IssuanceType = reader.GetString(9)  // Добавляем тип выдачи
                            };
                            data.Add(report);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return data;
        }

        private async Task<ObservableCollection<ReaderActivityReport>> LoadReaderActivityReportAsync()
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<ReaderActivityReport>();

            string query = @"
                SELECT 
                    r.ReaderID,
                    r.CardNumber,
                    CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(r.MiddleName, '')) AS FullName,
                    rt.TypeName,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Студент' THEN ISNULL(g.GroupCode, '')
                        WHEN rt.TypeName = 'Сотрудник' THEN ISNULL(p.Post_Name, '')
                        ELSE ''
                    END AS GroupOrPost,
                    COUNT(CASE WHEN i.Status = 'Возвращена' THEN 1 END) AS BooksReturned,
                    COUNT(CASE WHEN i.Status = 'Выдана' THEN 1 END) AS CurrentlyIssued,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN i.ReturnDate IS NULL AND i.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OverdueBooks,
                    MAX(i.IssuanceDate) AS LastIssuanceDate
                FROM ReaderForm r
                INNER JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
                LEFT JOIN BookIssuance i ON r.ReaderID = i.ReaderId
                GROUP BY r.ReaderID, r.CardNumber, r.LastName, r.FirstName, r.MiddleName, 
                         rt.TypeName, g.GroupCode, p.Post_Name
                ORDER BY CurrentlyIssued DESC, BooksReturned DESC";

            using (SqlConnection conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync();
                using (SqlCommand cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                using (SqlDataReader reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                {
                    while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                    {
                        int booksReturned = reader.GetInt32(5);
                        int currentlyIssued = reader.GetInt32(6);

                        var report = new ReaderActivityReport
                        {
                            ReaderID = reader.GetInt32(0),
                            CardNumber = reader.GetString(1),
                            FullName = reader.GetString(2),
                            TypeName = reader.GetString(3),
                            GroupOrPost = reader.GetString(4),
                            BooksReturned = booksReturned,
                            CurrentlyIssued = currentlyIssued,
                            OverdueBooks = reader.GetInt32(7),
                            LastIssuanceDate = reader.IsDBNull(8) ? (DateTime?)null : reader.GetDateTime(8),
                            BooksIssued = booksReturned + currentlyIssued
                        };
                        data.Add(report);
                    }
                }
            }

            return data;
        }

        private async Task<ObservableCollection<BookFundGroupedReport>> LoadBookFundReportAsync()
        {
            var data = new ObservableCollection<BookFundGroupedReport>();

            string query = @"
        WITH IssuanceStats AS (
            -- Индивидуальные выдачи
            SELECT 
                b.TitleBook,
                COUNT(*) AS IssuedCount
            FROM BookIssuance bi
            INNER JOIN Books b ON bi.BookId = b.IDBook
            WHERE bi.ReturnDate IS NULL AND bi.Status = 'Выдана'
            GROUP BY b.TitleBook
            
            UNION ALL
            
            -- Групповые выдачи
            SELECT 
                b.TitleBook,
                SUM(gii.Quantity - gii.ReturnedQuantity) AS IssuedCount
            FROM GroupBookIssuance gbi
            INNER JOIN GroupIssuanceItems gii ON gbi.GroupIssuanceId = gii.GroupIssuanceId
            INNER JOIN Books b ON gii.BookId = b.IDBook
            WHERE gbi.ReturnDate IS NULL AND gbi.Status = 'Выдана'
            GROUP BY b.TitleBook
        ),
        TotalIssued AS (
            SELECT 
                TitleBook,
                SUM(IssuedCount) AS TotalIssued
            FROM IssuanceStats
            GROUP BY TitleBook
        ),
        DisposedStats AS (
            SELECT 
                TitleBook,
                COUNT(*) AS DisposedCount
            FROM Books
            WHERE StatusBook = 5
            GROUP BY TitleBook
        )
        SELECT 
            b.TitleBook,
            MAX(CONCAT(a.SurnameAuthor, ' ', a.NameAuthor, ' ', ISNULL(a.PatronymicAuthor, ''))) AS AuthorName,
            MAX(ISNULL(ph.TitlePublishingHouse, '')) AS Publisher,
            MAX(b.YearPublishing) AS Year,
            MAX(ISNULL(g.TitleGener, '')) AS Genre,
            COUNT(*) AS TotalCopies,
            COUNT(*) - ISNULL(MAX(ti.TotalIssued), 0) - ISNULL(MAX(ds.DisposedCount), 0) AS AvailableCopies,
            ISNULL(MAX(ti.TotalIssued), 0) AS CopiesInUse,
            ISNULL(MAX(ds.DisposedCount), 0) AS DisposedCopies
        FROM Books b
        INNER JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
        LEFT JOIN PublishingHouse ph ON b.PublishingHouse = ph.IDPublishingHouse
        LEFT JOIN GenersBook g ON b.Gener = g.ID_Gener
        LEFT JOIN TotalIssued ti ON b.TitleBook = ti.TitleBook
        LEFT JOIN DisposedStats ds ON b.TitleBook = ds.TitleBook
        GROUP BY b.TitleBook
        ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

            using (SqlConnection conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync();
                using (SqlCommand cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                using (SqlDataReader reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                {
                    while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                    {
                        var report = new BookFundGroupedReport
                        {
                            Title = reader.GetString(0),
                            AuthorName = reader.GetString(1),
                            Publisher = reader.GetString(2),
                            Year = reader.GetInt32(3),
                            Genre = reader.GetString(4),
                            TotalCopies = reader.GetInt32(5),
                            AvailableCopies = reader.GetInt32(6),
                            CopiesInUse = reader.GetInt32(7),
                            DisposedCopies = reader.GetInt32(8)
                        };
                        data.Add(report);
                    }
                }
            }

            return data;
        }
