        /// <summary>
        /// Получает список выдач за указанную дату
        /// </summary>
        /// <summary>
        /// Получает список выдач за указанную дату
        /// </summary>
        public ObservableCollection<IssuanceItem> GetIssuancesByDate(DateTime date)
        {
            var issuances = new ObservableCollection<IssuanceItem>();

            try
            {
                // Индивидуальные выдачи
                string individualQuery = @"
            SELECT 
                'individual' AS IssuanceType,
                i.IssuanceId AS Id,
                i.IssuanceDate,
                i.PlannedReturnDate,
                i.ReturnDate,
                i.Status,
                r.ReaderID AS RecipientId,
                CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', r.MiddleName) AS RecipientName,
                'Читатель' AS RecipientType,
                b.IDBook AS IDBook,
                b.TitleBook AS BookTitle,
                b.InventaryNumber,
                1 AS Quantity,
                i.Notes
            FROM BookIssuance i
            INNER JOIN ReaderForm r ON i.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
            INNER JOIN Books b ON i.BookId = b.IDBook
            WHERE CAST(i.IssuanceDate AS DATE) = @Date";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();

                    // Получаем индивидуальные выдачи
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(individualQuery, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date", date.Date);
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                var item = new IssuanceItem
                                {
                                    IssuanceType = reader["IssuanceType"].ToString(),
                                    Id = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Id"]),
                                    IssuanceDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssuanceDate"]),
                                    PlannedReturnDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]),
                                    ReturnDate = reader["ReturnDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReturnDate"]) : (DateTime?)null,
                                    Status = reader["Status"].ToString(),
                                    RecipientId = reader["RecipientId"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["RecipientId"]) : 0,
                                    RecipientName = reader["RecipientName"].ToString(),
                                    RecipientType = reader["RecipientType"].ToString(),
                                    IDBook = reader["IDBook"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDBook"]) : 0,
                                    BookTitle = reader["BookTitle"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    InventaryNumber = reader["InventaryNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    Quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"]),
                                    Notes = reader["Notes"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    DisplayBook = reader["BookTitle"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                                };
                                item.OverdueColor = item.IsOverdue ?
                                    new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#DC3545")) :
                                    new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#28A745"));
                                issuances.Add(item);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Групповые выдачи (сгруппированные по группам и книгам)
                    string groupQuery = @"
                SELECT 
                    gi.GroupIssuanceId AS Id,
                    gi.IssuanceDate,
                    gi.PlannedReturnDate,
                    gi.ReturnDate,
                    gi.Status,
                    g.GroupCode AS GroupCode,
                    t.LastName + ' ' + t.FirstName AS TeacherName,
                    s.LastName + ' ' + s.FirstName AS StudentName,
                    b.TitleBook,
                    ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                    SUM(git.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity
                FROM GroupBookIssuance gi
                INNER JOIN Groups g ON gi.GroupId = g.GroupID
                INNER JOIN ReaderForm t ON gi.TeacherId = t.ReaderID
                LEFT JOIN ReaderForm s ON gi.StudentId = s.ReaderID
                INNER JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON gi.GroupIssuanceId = git.GroupIssuanceId
                INNER JOIN Books b ON git.BookId = b.IDBook
                LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                WHERE CAST(gi.IssuanceDate AS DATE) = @Date
                GROUP BY gi.GroupIssuanceId, gi.IssuanceDate, gi.PlannedReturnDate, gi.ReturnDate, 
                         gi.Status, g.GroupCode, t.LastName, t.FirstName, s.LastName, s.FirstName,
                         b.TitleBook, a.SurnameAuthor, a.NameAuthor, a.PatronymicAuthor
                ORDER BY gi.IssuanceDate DESC, b.TitleBook";

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(groupQuery, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date", date.Date);
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            var groupIssuancesDict = new Dictionary<int, IssuanceItem>();

                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                int id = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Id"]);
                                string bookTitle = reader["TitleBook"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                string authorName = reader["AuthorName"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                int quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalQuantity"]);
                                string bookDisplay = $"{bookTitle} - {authorName} ({quantity} шт.)";

                                if (!groupIssuancesDict.ContainsKey(id))
                                {
                                    groupIssuancesDict.Add(id, new IssuanceItem
                                    {
                                        IssuanceType = "group",
                                        Id = id,
                                        IssuanceDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssuanceDate"]),
                                        PlannedReturnDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]),
                                        ReturnDate = reader["ReturnDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReturnDate"]) : (DateTime?)null,
                                        Status = reader["Status"].ToString(),
                                        RecipientName = $"{reader["GroupCode"]} - {reader["TeacherName"]}",
                                        RecipientType = "Группа",
                                        Notes = "",
                                        BookList = new List<string>(),
                                        Quantity = 0
                                    });
                                }

                                // Добавляем сгруппированную книгу
                                groupIssuancesDict[id].BookList.Add(bookDisplay);
                                groupIssuancesDict[id].Quantity += quantity;
                            }

                            // Добавляем сгруппированные выдачи в коллекцию
                            foreach (var item in groupIssuancesDict.Values)
                            {
                                // Формируем DisplayBook как многострочный текст
                                item.DisplayBook = string.Join("\n", item.BookList);
                                item.OverdueColor = item.IsOverdue ?
                                    new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#DC3545")) :
                                    new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#28A745"));
                                issuances.Add(item);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Загружено выдач: {issuances.Count}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки выдач: {ex.Message}");
                throw;
            }

            return issuances;
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Получает список книг для групповой выдачи
        /// </summary>
        private string GetGroupIssuanceBooksList(int groupIssuanceId)
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
            SELECT b.TitleBook, git.Quantity
            FROM GroupIssuanceItems git
            INNER JOIN Books b ON git.BookId = b.IDBook
            WHERE git.GroupIssuanceId = @GroupIssuanceId";

                var books = new List<string>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupIssuanceId", groupIssuanceId);
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                string title = reader["TitleBook"].ToString();
                                int quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"]);
                                books.Add($"{title} ({quantity} экз.)");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                return string.Join(", ", books);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки книг групповой выдачи: {ex.Message}");
                return "Ошибка загрузки";
            }
        }

        public int CreateGroupIssuanceWithBooks(
            int groupId,
            int teacherId,
            int studentId,
            DateTime plannedReturnDate,
            List<int> IDBooks,
            string subjectName = "",
            string notes = "")
        {
            if (IDBooks == null || IDBooks.Count == 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Список книг не может быть пустым");

            string IDBooksString = string.Join(",", IDBooks);

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("sp_CreateGroupIssuance", conn))
                {
                    cmd.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;

                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupId", groupId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TeacherId", teacherId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StudentId", studentId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PlannedReturnDate", plannedReturnDate);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SubjectName", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(subjectName) ? DBNull.Value : (object)subjectName);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Notes", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(notes) ? DBNull.Value : (object)notes);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BookIds", IDBooksString);

                    var outputParam = cmd.Parameters.Add("@GroupIssuanceId", SqlDbType.Int);
                    outputParam.Direction = ParameterDirection.Output;

                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();

                    return Convert.ToInt32(outputParam.Value);
                }
            }
        }

using Diplom_Bibl.Interfaces;
using System;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class BookService
    {
        private readonly IBookRepository _repository;

        public BookService(IBookRepository repository)
        {
            _repository = repository;
        }

        public int AddBook(string invNumber, string title, int authorId, int? publisherId,
                          int year, int? genreId, int? statusId, string annotation,
                          int? receiptId, int viewId, string price)
        {
            // Валидация обязательных полей
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(invNumber))
                throw new ArgumentException("Инвентарный номер не может быть пустым");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title))
                throw new ArgumentException("Название не может быть пустым");

            if (authorId <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Не выбран автор");

            if (viewId <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Не выбран вид книги");

            // Проверка года
            if (year < 1000 || year > DateTime.Now.Year)
                throw new ArgumentException($"Год должен быть от 1000 до {DateTime.Now.Year}");

            // Проверка уникальности инвентарного номера
            if (_repository.BookExists(invNumber.Trim()))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Инвентарный номер уже существует");

            // Сохранение книги
            return _repository.InsertBook(
                invNumber.Trim(),
                title.Trim(),
                authorId,
                publisherId,
                year,
                genreId,
                statusId,
                annotation?.Trim(),
                receiptId,
                viewId,
                price?.Trim());
        }
    }
}

// STAGE 2: Сервис управления сессиями ПК
using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class ComputerSessionService
    {

        private readonly string _connectionString;
        public ComputerSessionService(string connectionString)
        {
            _connectionString = connectionString;
        }
        public ComputerSessionService() : this(DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString)
        {
        }
        public class SessionItem
        {
            public int ID_Session { get; set; }
            public string ComputerNumber { get; set; } = "";
            public int UserID { get; set; }
            public string FullName { get; set; } = "";
            public string GroupCode { get; set; } = "";
            public string Purpose { get; set; } = "";
            public DateTime StartTime { get; set; }
            public DateTime? EndTime { get; set; }
            public int? Duration { get; set; }
            public string Status { get; set; } = "";
            public bool IsActive => Status == "Active";
            public string StartTimeDisplay => StartTime.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm");
            public string EndTimeDisplay => EndTime?.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm") ?? "Активна";
            public string DurationDisplay => Duration.HasValue ? $"{Duration.Value} мин" : "—";
            public string CurrentDuration
            {
                get
                {
                    if (!IsActive) return DurationDisplay;
                    TimeSpan duration = DateTime.Now - StartTime;
                    return $"{duration.Hours:D2}:{duration.Minutes:D2}:{duration.Seconds:D2}";
                }
            }
            public string StatusDisplay => Status == "Active" ? "Активна" : (Status == "Completed" ? "Завершена" : "Прервана");

        }
       

        // Создание новой сессии
        public async Task<int> CreateSessionAsync(string computerNumber, int userId, string fullName,
            string groupCode, string purpose)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                INSERT INTO ComputerSessions (ComputerNumber, UserID, FullName, GroupCode, Purpose, 
                    StartTime, Status, CreatedDate)
                VALUES (@ComputerNumber, @UserID, @FullName, @GroupCode, @Purpose, 
                    @StartTime, 'Active', GETDATE());
                SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY();";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ComputerNumber", computerNumber);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserID", userId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@FullName", fullName);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupCode", string.IsNullOrEmpty(groupCode) ? (object)DBNull.Value : groupCode);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Purpose", purpose);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StartTime", DateTime.Now);

                    int sessionId = Convert.ToInt32(await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync().ConfigureAwait(false));
                    await AddLogAsync(sessionId, "Создана", "Сессия начата").ConfigureAwait(false);
                    return sessionId;
                }
            }
        }

        // Завершение сессии
        public async Task<bool> EndSessionAsync(int sessionId)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                UPDATE ComputerSessions 
                SET EndTime = @EndTime, Status = 'Completed'
                WHERE ID_Session = @SessionId AND Status = 'Active'";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EndTime", DateTime.Now);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SessionId", sessionId);
                    int rows = await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);

                    if (rows > 0)
                    {
                        await AddLogAsync(sessionId, "Завершена", "Сессия завершена").ConfigureAwait(false);
                        return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        // Аварийное завершение (при закрытии приложения)
        public async Task TerminateActiveSessionAsync(int userId, string computerNumber)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                UPDATE ComputerSessions 
                SET EndTime = @EndTime, Status = 'Terminated'
                WHERE UserID = @UserId AND ComputerNumber = @ComputerNumber AND Status = 'Active'";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EndTime", DateTime.Now);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserId", userId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ComputerNumber", computerNumber);
                    await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
            }
        }

        // Добавление записи в лог
        private async Task AddLogAsync(int sessionId, string action, string details)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                INSERT INTO ComputerLogs (SessionID, Action, ActionTime, Details)
                VALUES (@SessionId, @Action, @ActionTime, @Details)";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SessionId", sessionId);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Action", action);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ActionTime", DateTime.Now);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Details", details ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                    await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
            }
        }

        // Проверка активной сессии для пользователя
        public async Task<bool> HasActiveSessionAsync(int userId)
        {
            const string sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ComputerSessions WHERE UserID = @UserId AND Status = 'Active'";
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserId", userId);
                    int count = (int)await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                    return count > 0;
                }
            }
        }

        // Получение списка активных сессий для панели библиотекаря
        public async Task<ObservableCollection<SessionItem>> GetActiveSessionsAsync()
        {
            var sessions = new ObservableCollection<SessionItem>();
            const string sql = @"
        SELECT ID_Session, ComputerNumber, UserID, FullName, ISNULL(GroupCode, '') AS GroupCode,
               Purpose, StartTime, EndTime, Duration, Status
        FROM ComputerSessions
        WHERE Status = 'Active'
        ORDER BY StartTime DESC";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync().ConfigureAwait(false))
                {
                    while (await reader.ReadAsync().ConfigureAwait(false))
                    {
                        sessions.Add(new SessionItem
                        {
                            ID_Session = reader.GetInt32(0),
                            ComputerNumber = reader.GetString(1),
                            UserID = reader.GetInt32(2),
                            FullName = reader.GetString(3),
                            GroupCode = reader.GetString(4),
                            Purpose = reader.GetString(5),
                            StartTime = reader.GetDateTime(6),
                            EndTime = reader.IsDBNull(7) ? (DateTime?)null : reader.GetDateTime(7),
                            Duration = reader.IsDBNull(8) ? (int?)null : reader.GetInt32(8),
                            Status = reader.GetString(9)

                    }

        // Получение истории сессий (завершенные)
        public async Task<ObservableCollection<SessionItem>> GetCompletedSessionsAsync(DateTime? fromDate = null, DateTime? toDate = null)
        {
            var sessions = new ObservableCollection<SessionItem>();
            string sql = @"
        SELECT ID_Session, ComputerNumber, UserID, FullName, ISNULL(GroupCode, '') AS GroupCode,
               Purpose, StartTime, EndTime, Duration, Status
        FROM ComputerSessions
        WHERE Status IN ('Completed', 'Terminated')";

            if (fromDate.HasValue)
                sql += " AND StartTime >= @FromDate";
            if (toDate.HasValue)
                sql += " AND StartTime <= @ToDate";

            sql += " ORDER BY StartTime DESC";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    if (fromDate.HasValue)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@FromDate", fromDate.Value);
                    if (toDate.HasValue)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ToDate", toDate.Value);

                    using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync().ConfigureAwait(false))
                    {
                        while (await reader.ReadAsync().ConfigureAwait(false))
                        {
                            sessions.Add(new SessionItem
                            {
                                ID_Session = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                ComputerNumber = reader.GetString(1),
                                UserID = reader.GetInt32(2),
                                FullName = reader.GetString(3),
                                GroupCode = reader.GetString(4),
                                Purpose = reader.GetString(5),
                                StartTime = reader.GetDateTime(6),
                                EndTime = reader.IsDBNull(7) ? (DateTime?)null : reader.GetDateTime(7),
                                Duration = reader.IsDBNull(8) ? (int?)null : reader.GetInt32(8),
                                Status = reader.GetString(9)
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return sessions;
        }

        // Принудительное завершение сессии библиотекарем
        public async Task<bool> ForceEndSessionAsync(int sessionId, string reason)
        {
            const string sql = @"
        UPDATE ComputerSessions 
        SET EndTime = @EndTime, Status = 'Terminated'
        WHERE ID_Session = @SessionId AND Status = 'Active'";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                await conn.OpenAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EndTime", DateTime.Now);
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SessionId", sessionId);
                    int rows = await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);

                    if (rows > 0)
                    {
                        await AddLogAsync(sessionId, "Принудительно завершена", reason).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

using Diplom_Bibl.Interfaces;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class GenreService
    {
        private readonly IGenreRepository _repository;

        public GenreService(IGenreRepository repository)
        {
            _repository = repository;
        }

        public int AddGenre(string title)
        {
            // Валидация
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title))
                throw new ArgumentException("Название жанра не может быть пустым");

            // Очищаем от пробелов
            string trimmedTitle = title.Trim();

            // Проверка на дубликат
            if (_repository.GenreExists(trimmedTitle))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Жанр '{trimmedTitle}' уже существует");

            // Сохраняем
            return _repository.InsertGenre(trimmedTitle);
        }

        public IEnumerable<dynamic> SearchGenres(string searchTerm)
        {
            var allGenres = _repository.GetAllGenres();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
                return allGenres;

            // Поиск без учета регистра
            return allGenres.Where(g =>
                g.TitleGener.IndexOf(searchTerm, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0);
        }

        public void UpdateGenre(int id, string title)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title))
                throw new ArgumentException("Название жанра не может быть пустым");

            string trimmedTitle = title.Trim();

            var existing = _repository.GetGenreById(id);
            if (existing == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Жанр не найден");

            // Если название изменилось, проверяем уникальность
            if (!existing.TitleGener.Equals(trimmedTitle, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                if (_repository.GenreExists(trimmedTitle))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"Жанр '{trimmedTitle}' уже существует");
            }

            _repository.UpdateGenre(id, trimmedTitle);
        }

        public void DeleteGenre(int id)
        {
            var existing = _repository.GetGenreById(id);
            if (existing == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Жанр не найден");

            _repository.DeleteGenre(id);
        }
    }
}

        /// <summary>
        /// Отметка уведомления как прочитанного
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="notificationId">ID уведомления</param>
        public async Task MarkAsReadAsync(int notificationId)
        {
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    string query = "UPDATE RequestNotifications SET IsRead = 1 WHERE ID_Notification = @Id";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Id", notificationId);
                        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                    }
                }

                var notification = _notifications.FirstOrDefault(n => n.ID_Notification == notificationId);
                if (notification != null)
                {
                    notification.IsRead = true;
                    _notifications.Remove(notification);
                    _dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                    {
                        NotificationsUpdated?.Invoke(this, _notifications);
                        UnreadCountChanged?.Invoke(this, GetUnreadCount());
                    });
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка отметки прочитанного: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

                    if (IsLibrarianOrAdmin())

                        // Для читателя - только свои уведомления

                            WHERE br.UserID = @UserId AND n.IsRead = 0";

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))

                        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                    }
                }

                _notifications.Clear();
                _dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                {
                    NotificationsUpdated?.Invoke(this, _notifications);
                    UnreadCountChanged?.Invoke(this, GetUnreadCount());
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)

                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка: {ex.Message}");

        private async void LoadInitialNotifications()
        {
            try
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("?? ЗАГРУЗКА УВЕДОМЛЕНИЙ (Initial)");

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();

                    string query;
                    bool isLibrarian = IsLibrarianOrAdmin();

                    if (isLibrarian)
                    {
                        query = @"
                    SELECT TOP 20 
                        n.ID_Notification, 
                        n.RequestID, 
                        n.Message, 
                        nt.TypeName AS NotificationType,
                        n.CreatedDate, 
                        n.IsRead,
                        ISNULL(br.RequestNumber, '') AS RequestNumber,
                        br.ExpirationDate,
                        ISNULL(rf.LastName + ' ' + rf.FirstName + ' ' + rf.MiddleName, 'Системное уведомление') AS UserName,
                        ISNULL(g.GroupCode, '') AS GroupName,
                        ISNULL(br.LessonName, '') AS LessonName,
                        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), br.LessonDate, 104) AS LessonDate,
                        ISNULL(LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), br.LessonTime, 8), 5), '') AS LessonTime,
                        (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Quantity), 0) FROM RequestItems WHERE RequestID = br.ID_Request) AS BooksCount,
                        STUFF((
                            SELECT ', ' + b.TitleBook 
                            FROM RequestItems ri
                            INNER JOIN Books b ON ri.BookID = b.IDBook
                            WHERE ri.RequestID = br.ID_Request
                            FOR XML PATH('')
                        ), 1, 2, '') AS BookTitles
                    FROM RequestNotifications n
                    INNER JOIN NotificationTypes nt ON n.NotificationTypeID = nt.ID_Type
                    LEFT JOIN BookRequests br ON n.RequestID = br.ID_Request
                    LEFT JOIN ReaderForm rf ON br.UserID = rf.ReaderID
                    LEFT JOIN Groups g ON rf.GroupID = g.GroupID
                    WHERE n.IsRead = 0
                    ORDER BY n.CreatedDate DESC";

                    else

                        br.ExpirationDate
                    FROM RequestNotifications n
                    INNER JOIN NotificationTypes nt ON n.NotificationTypeID = nt.ID_Type
                    LEFT JOIN BookRequests br ON n.RequestID = br.ID_Request
                    WHERE (br.UserID = @UserId OR n.RequestID IS NULL)
                      AND n.IsRead = 0 
                      AND nt.TypeName <> 'Новая заявка'
                    ORDER BY n.CreatedDate DESC";

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        if (!isLibrarian)

                        }

                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            _notifications.Clear();
                            int maxId = 0;
                            int count = 0;

                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())

                                count++;

                                int? requestId = null;
                                if (!reader.IsDBNull(1))
                                    requestId = reader.GetInt32(1);

                                var notification = new NotificationItem
                                {

                                    Message = reader.IsDBNull(2) ? "" : reader.GetString(2),
                                    NotificationType = reader.IsDBNull(3) ? "" : reader.GetString(3),
                                    CreatedDate = reader.GetDateTime(4),
                                    IsRead = reader.GetBoolean(5),
                                    RequestNumber = reader.IsDBNull(6) ? "" : reader.GetString(6),

                                };

                                if (isLibrarian)
                                {
                                    notification.UserName = reader.IsDBNull(8) ? "" : reader.GetString(8);
                                    notification.GroupName = reader.IsDBNull(9) ? "" : reader.GetString(9);
                                    notification.LessonName = reader.IsDBNull(10) ? "" : reader.GetString(10);
                                    notification.LessonDate = reader.IsDBNull(11) ? "" : reader.GetString(11);
                                    notification.LessonTime = reader.IsDBNull(12) ? "" : reader.GetString(12);
                                    notification.BooksCount = reader.IsDBNull(13) ? 0 : reader.GetInt32(13);
                                    notification.BookTitles = reader.IsDBNull(14) ? "" : reader.GetString(14);
                                }

                                _notifications.Add(notification);

                                if (notification.ID_Notification > maxId)
                                    maxId = notification.ID_Notification;
                            }

                            _lastNotificationId = maxId;
                            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"? Загружено уведомлений: {count}, последний ID: {_lastNotificationId}");
                            _dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                            {
                                NotificationsUpdated?.Invoke(this, _notifications);
                                UnreadCountChanged?.Invoke(this, GetUnreadCount());
                            });
                            
                           
                            ShowAllUnreadNotifications();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"? Ошибка загрузки уведомлений: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
            }
        }
        /// Периодическая проверка новых уведомлений (выполняется в фоновом потоке)
        /// </summary>
        private async Task PollNotificationsAsync()
        {
            if (_isDisposed) return;

            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();

                    string query;
                    bool isLibrarian = IsLibrarianOrAdmin();

                    if (isLibrarian)
                    {
                        // =========================================
                        // ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ДЛЯ БИБЛИОТЕКАРЯ:
                        // Используем LEFT JOIN вместо INNER JOIN,
                        // чтобы уведомления с RequestID = NULL тоже выбирались
                        // =========================================
                        query = @"
            SELECT 
                n.ID_Notification, 
                n.RequestID, 
                n.Message, 
                nt.TypeName AS NotificationType,
                n.CreatedDate, 
                n.IsRead,
                ISNULL(br.RequestNumber, '') AS RequestNumber,
                br.ExpirationDate,
                ISNULL(rf.LastName + ' ' + rf.FirstName + ' ' + rf.MiddleName, 'Системное уведомление') AS UserName,
                ISNULL(g.GroupCode, '') AS GroupName,
                ISNULL(br.LessonName, '') AS LessonName,
                FORMAT(br.LessonDate, 'dd.MM.yyyy') AS LessonDate,
                ISNULL(LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), br.LessonTime, 8), 5), '') AS LessonTime,
                ISNULL((SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Quantity), 0) FROM RequestItems WHERE RequestID = br.ID_Request), 0) AS BooksCount,
                ISNULL(STUFF((
                    SELECT ', ' + b.TitleBook 
                    FROM RequestItems ri
                    INNER JOIN Books b ON ri.BookID = b.IDBook
                    WHERE ri.RequestID = br.ID_Request
                    FOR XML PATH('')
                ), 1, 2, ''), '') AS BookTitles
            FROM RequestNotifications n
            INNER JOIN NotificationTypes nt ON n.NotificationTypeID = nt.ID_Type
            LEFT JOIN BookRequests br ON n.RequestID = br.ID_Request  -- < LEFT JOIN вместо INNER JOIN!
            LEFT JOIN ReaderForm rf ON br.UserID = rf.ReaderID
            LEFT JOIN Groups g ON rf.GroupID = g.GroupID
            WHERE n.ID_Notification > @LastId AND n.IsRead = 0
            ORDER BY n.CreatedDate DESC";
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // =========================================
                        // ДЛЯ ЧИТАТЕЛЯ - тоже LEFT JOIN
                        // =========================================
                        query = @"
            SELECT 
                n.ID_Notification, 
                n.RequestID, 
                n.Message, 
                nt.TypeName AS NotificationType,
                n.CreatedDate, 
                n.IsRead,
                ISNULL(br.RequestNumber, '') AS RequestNumber,
                br.ExpirationDate,
                '' AS UserName,
                '' AS GroupName,
                '' AS LessonName,
                '' AS LessonDate,
                '' AS LessonTime,
                0 AS BooksCount,
                '' AS BookTitles
            FROM RequestNotifications n
            INNER JOIN NotificationTypes nt ON n.NotificationTypeID = nt.ID_Type
            LEFT JOIN BookRequests br ON n.RequestID = br.ID_Request  -- < LEFT JOIN вместо INNER JOIN!
            WHERE (br.UserID = @UserId OR n.RequestID IS NULL)  -- < Добавляем условие для уведомлений без заявки
              AND n.ID_Notification > @LastId 
              AND n.IsRead = 0 
              AND nt.TypeName <> 'Новая заявка'
            ORDER BY n.CreatedDate DESC";
                    }

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        if (!isLibrarian)
                        {
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserId", _currentUserId);
                        }
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@LastId", _lastNotificationId);

                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            int newCount = 0;
                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                newCount++;

                                // Безопасное чтение RequestID (может быть NULL)
                                int? requestId = null;
                                if (!reader.IsDBNull(1))
                                    requestId = reader.GetInt32(1);

                                var notification = new NotificationItem
                                {
                                    ID_Notification = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                    RequestID = requestId ?? 0,
                                    Message = reader.IsDBNull(2) ? "" : reader.GetString(2),
                                    NotificationType = reader.IsDBNull(3) ? "" : reader.GetString(3),
                                    CreatedDate = reader.GetDateTime(4),
                                    IsRead = reader.GetBoolean(5),
                                    RequestNumber = reader.IsDBNull(6) ? "" : reader.GetString(6),
                                    ExpirationDate = reader.IsDBNull(7) ? (DateTime?)null : reader.GetDateTime(7),
                                    UserName = reader.IsDBNull(8) ? "" : reader.GetString(8),
                                    GroupName = reader.IsDBNull(9) ? "" : reader.GetString(9),
                                    LessonName = reader.IsDBNull(10) ? "" : reader.GetString(10),
                                    LessonDate = reader.IsDBNull(11) ? "" : reader.GetString(11),
                                    LessonTime = reader.IsDBNull(12) ? "" : reader.GetString(12),
                                    BooksCount = reader.IsDBNull(13) ? 0 : reader.GetInt32(13),
                                    BookTitles = reader.IsDBNull(14) ? "" : reader.GetString(14)
                                };

                                lock (_lockObject)
                                {
                                    if (notification.ID_Notification > _lastNotificationId)
                                        _lastNotificationId = notification.ID_Notification;
                                }


                                _dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                                {
                                    _notifications.Insert(0, notification);
                                    NotificationsUpdated?.Invoke(this, _notifications);
                                    UnreadCountChanged?.Invoke(this, GetUnreadCount());
                                    NewNotificationReceived?.Invoke(this, notification);  // < ЭТО ДЛЯ НОВЫХ

                                    System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"?? НОВОЕ УВЕДОМЛЕНИЕ: {notification.NotificationType} - {notification.Message}");
                                });
                            }

                            if (newCount > 0)
                                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"? Получено новых уведомлений: {newCount}");
                            else
                                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"?? Новых уведомлений нет, lastId={_lastNotificationId}");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"? Ошибка опроса: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Показывает все непрочитанные уведомления при инициализации
        /// </summary>
        /// <summary>
        /// Показывает все непрочитанные уведомления при инициализации
        /// </summary>
        private void ShowAllUnreadNotifications()
        {
            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"?? ПОКАЗ ВСЕХ НЕПРОЧИТАННЫХ УВЕДОМЛЕНИЙ: {_notifications.Count} шт.");

            foreach (var notification in _notifications)
            {
                if (!notification.IsRead)
                {
                    System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"?? ТРИГГЕР ДЛЯ ID={notification.ID_Notification}, Тип={notification.NotificationType}");
                    _dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                    {
                        // ВАЖНО: Вызываем событие для каждого уведомления
                        NewNotificationReceived?.Invoke(this, notification);
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        #endregion
    }
}

using Diplom_Bibl.Interfaces;
using System;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class ReceiptService
    {
        private readonly IReceiptRepository _repository;
        private readonly ReceiptNumberGenerator _generator;

        public ReceiptService(IReceiptRepository repository)
        {
            _repository = repository;
            _generator = new ReceiptNumberGenerator();
        }

        // Для тестирования с возможностью подмены генератора
        public ReceiptService(IReceiptRepository repository, ReceiptNumberGenerator generator)
        {
            _repository = repository;
            _generator = generator;
        }

        public int AddReceipt(int responsibleId, string comment)
        {
            // Валидация
            if (responsibleId <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Неверный ID ответственного лица");

            // Получаем следующий номер
            int nextId = _repository.GetNextReceiptNumber();
            string number = _generator.GenerateReceiptNumber(nextId);

            // Сохраняем накладную
            return _repository.InsertReceipt(
                number,
                DateTime.Now,
                responsibleId,
                comment ?? ""); // null comment -> пустая строка
        }
    }
}

using Diplom_Bibl.Interfaces;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public class UserService
    {
        private readonly IUserRepository _repository;

        public UserService(IUserRepository repository)
        {
            _repository = repository;
        }

        public int AddUser(string surname, string name, string patronymic,
                          string login, string password, List<int> roleIds)
        {
            // Валидация
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(surname))
                throw new ArgumentException("Фамилия не может быть пустой");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
                throw new ArgumentException("Имя не может быть пустым");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(login))
                throw new ArgumentException("Логин не может быть пустым");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password))
                throw new ArgumentException("Пароль не может быть пустым");

            if (roleIds == null || roleIds.Count == 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Должна быть выбрана хотя бы одна роль");

            // Проверка уникальности логина - ВАЖНО!
            if (_repository.LoginExists(login.Trim()))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Логин уже занят");

            // Создание пользователя
            int userId = _repository.InsertUser(
                surname.Trim(),
                name.Trim(),
                patronymic?.Trim() ?? "",
                login.Trim(),
                password);

            // Назначение ролей - ВАЖНО!
            if (userId > 0 && roleIds.Count > 0)
            {
                _repository.AssignRolesToUser(userId, roleIds);
            }

            return userId;
        }
    }
}

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Models

    public class User
    {

        public string Surname { get; set; } = "";
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";
        public string Patronymic { get; set; } = "";
        public string Login { get; set; } = "";
        public string PasswordHash { get; set; } = "";

        // Связь с читательским билетом
        public int? ReaderID { get; set; }

        // Информация из читательского билета
        public string CardNumber { get; set; } = "";
        public string LastName { get; set; } = "";
        public string FirstName { get; set; } = "";
        public string MiddleName { get; set; } = "";
        public int TypeID { get; set; }
        public string TypeName { get; set; } = "";
        public int? GroupID { get; set; }
        public string GroupCode { get; set; } = "";

        // Роли пользователя
        public List<string> Roles { get; set; } = new List<string>();

        public string FullName => $"{LastName} {FirstName} {MiddleName}".Trim();

        public bool IsAdmin => Roles.Contains("ADMIN");
        public bool IsLibrarian => Roles.Contains("LIBRARIAN");
        public bool IsReader => Roles.Contains("READER");
    }

using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Windows
{
    public partial class AutorisationWindow : Window
    {
       

    private readonly string _connectionString = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;

    public AutorisationWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            LoginPlaceholder.Visibility = string.IsNullOrEmpty(LoginBox.Text) ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Hidden;
            this.KeyDown += OnWindowKeyDown;
            LoginBox.KeyDown += OnLoginBoxKeyDown;
            PasswordBox.KeyDown += OnPasswordBoxKeyDown;
            VisiblePasswordBox.KeyDown += OnVisiblePasswordBoxKeyDown;
        }

        private void TogglePasswordVisibility_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            VisiblePasswordBox.Text = PasswordBox.Password;
            PasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            VisiblePasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            EyeIcon.Fill = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#007BFF"));
            VisiblePasswordBox.Focus();
            VisiblePasswordBox.CaretIndex = VisiblePasswordBox.Text.Length;
        }

        private void TogglePasswordVisibility_Unchecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            PasswordBox.Password = VisiblePasswordBox.Text;
            VisiblePasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PasswordBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            EyeIcon.Fill = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#999999"));
            PasswordBox.Focus();
        }

        private void PasswordBox_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            PasswordPlaceholder.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
        }

        private void PasswordBox_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            UpdatePasswordPlaceholder();
        }

        private void PasswordBox_PasswordChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            UpdatePasswordPlaceholder();
            if (VisiblePasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
            {
                VisiblePasswordBox.Text = PasswordBox.Password;
            }
        }

        private void UpdatePasswordPlaceholder()
        {
            PasswordPlaceholder.Visibility = string.IsNullOrEmpty(PasswordBox.Password) ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Hidden;
        }

        private void OnWindowKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Enter)
            {
                _ = PerformLoginAsync();
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        }

        private void OnLoginBoxKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Enter)
            {
                if (PasswordBox.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
                    PasswordBox.Focus();
                else
                    VisiblePasswordBox.Focus();
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        }

        private void OnPasswordBoxKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Enter)
            {
                _ = PerformLoginAsync();
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        }

        private void OnVisiblePasswordBoxKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.Enter)
            {
                PasswordBox.Password = VisiblePasswordBox.Text;
                _ = PerformLoginAsync();
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        }

        private async Task PerformLoginAsync()
        {
            string login = LoginBox.Text.Trim();
            string password = PasswordBox.Password;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(login) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите логин и пароль!", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();

                    string query = @"
                SELECT 
                    u.ID_User,
                    u.Surname,
                    u.Name,
                    u.Patronymic,
                    u.Login,
                    u.PasswordHash,
                    u.ReaderID,
                    r.CardNumber,
                    r.LastName,
                    r.FirstName,
                    r.MiddleName,
                    r.TypeID,
                    r.Post,
                    p.Post_Name,
                    rt.TypeName,
                    r.GroupID,
                    g.GroupCode
                FROM Users u
                LEFT JOIN ReaderForm r ON u.ReaderID = r.ReaderID
                LEFT JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
                LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                WHERE u.Login = @Login OR r.CardNumber = @CardNumber";

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        // Добавляем оба параметра
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Login", login);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CardNumber", login);

                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            if (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                string storedHash = reader["PasswordHash"].ToString();

                                if (BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.Verify(password, storedHash))
                                {
                                    int userId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_User"]);
                                    int readerId = reader["ReaderID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["ReaderID"]) : 0;
                                    int userTypeId = reader["TypeID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["TypeID"]) : 1;

                                    // Формируем ФИО (если нет данных из ReaderForm, используем данные из Users)
                                    string lastName = reader["LastName"]?.ToString() ?? reader["Surname"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                    string firstName = reader["FirstName"]?.ToString() ?? reader["Name"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                    string middleName = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString() ?? reader["Patronymic"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                    string fullName = $"{lastName} {firstName} {middleName}".Trim();

                                    // Если ФИО пустое, используем логин
                                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fullName))
                                    {
                                        fullName = reader["Login"]?.ToString() ?? "Пользователь";
                                    }

                                    reader.Close();

                                    var roles = await GetUserRoles(login);

                                    var mainWindow = new MainWindow(userId, readerId, fullName, roles, userTypeId);
                                    mainWindow.Show();
                                    this.Close();
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    CustomMessageBox.Show("Неверный пароль!", "Ошибка",
                                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                CustomMessageBox.Show("Пользователь не найден!\n\nПроверьте логин или номер читательского билета.", "Ошибка",
                                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при входе: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }
        //  метод получения ролей
        private async Task<List<string>> GetUserRoles(string login)
        {
            var roles = new List<string>();

            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();

                    string getUserIdQuery = @"
                SELECT u.ID_User 
                FROM Users u
                LEFT JOIN ReaderForm r ON u.ReaderID = r.ReaderID
                WHERE u.Login = @Login OR r.CardNumber = @CardNumber";

                    int userId = 0;

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(getUserIdQuery, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Login", login);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CardNumber", login);
                        var result = await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync();
                        if (result != null)
                            userId = Convert.ToInt32(result);
                    }

                    if (userId > 0)
                    {
                        string query = @"
                    SELECT r.RoleCode 
                    FROM UserRolesAssignments ura
                    INNER JOIN UserRoles r ON ura.ID_Role = r.ID_Role
                    WHERE ura.ID_User = @UserId";

                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                        {
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserId", userId);
                            using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                            {
                                while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                                {
                                    roles.Add(reader["RoleCode"].ToString());
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки ролей: {ex.Message}");
            }

            if (roles.Count == 0)
            {
                roles.Add("READER");
            }

            return roles;
        }
        private async void LoginButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            await PerformLoginAsync();
        }

        private void LoginBox_TextChanged(object sender, System.Windows.Controls.TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoginPlaceholder.Visibility = string.IsNullOrEmpty(LoginBox.Text) ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Hidden;
        }
    }

using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;
using Diplom_Bibl.Services;
using System;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Interop;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Windows
{
    public partial class ComputerSessionWindow : Window
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;
        private readonly int _userId;
        private readonly int _readerId;
        private readonly string _fullName;
        private readonly string _groupCode;
        private readonly ComputerSessionService _sessionService;
        private int _currentSessionId;
        private bool _isRegistered = false;

        private const int WS_MINIMIZEBOX = 0x00020000;
        private const int GWL_STYLE = -16;

        public ComputerSessionWindow(int userId, int readerId, string fullName, string groupCode)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _userId = userId;
            _readerId = readerId;
            _fullName = fullName;
            _groupCode = groupCode;
            _sessionService = new ComputerSessionService();
            Loaded += ComputerSessionWindow_Loaded;
        }

        //загрузка окна записи на использование компьютером

        private void ComputerSessionWindow_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            TbDateTime.Text = DateTime.Now.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss");
            TbFullName.Text = _fullName;

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_groupCode))
                TbGroup.Text = _groupCode;
            else
                GroupPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

            string computerNumber = ParseComputerNumber(Environment.MachineName);
            TbComputerNumber.Text = computerNumber;
            TbPurpose.Focus();
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// парсинг наименования компьютера из настроек системы
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="machineName"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private string ParseComputerNumber(string machineName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(machineName)) return "Неизвестно";
            Match match = Regex.Match(machineName, @"[\d]+$");
            if (match.Success) return match.Value;
            return machineName.Length > 15 ? machineName.Substring(0, 15) : machineName;
        }

        private void LockMinimizeButton()
        {
            try
            {
                WindowInteropHelper helper = new WindowInteropHelper(this);
                IntPtr handle = helper.Handle;
                int style = NativeMethods.GetWindowLong(handle, GWL_STYLE);
                style &= ~WS_MINIMIZEBOX;
                NativeMethods.SetWindowLong(handle, GWL_STYLE, style);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка блокировки сворачивания: {ex.Message}"); }
        }

        private async void BtnRegister_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TbPurpose.Text))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Укажите цель использования компьютера.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                TbPurpose.Focus();
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                _currentSessionId = await _sessionService.CreateSessionAsync(TbComputerNumber.Text, _userId, TbFullName.Text, TbGroup.Text, TbPurpose.Text.Trim());
                _isRegistered = true;

                BtnRegister.IsEnabled = false;
                BtnCancel.IsEnabled = false;
                TbPurpose.IsEnabled = false;
                LockMinimizeButton();

                CustomMessageBox.Show("Вы успешно зарегистрированы!\n",
                    "Успешно", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);

                //if (_currentSessionId > 0)
                //{
                //    var mainWindow = Application.Current.MainWindow as MainWindow;
                //    if (mainWindow != null)
                //        await mainWindow.SendComputerSessionNotificationToLibrarian(_fullName, _groupCode);
                //}
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка регистрации: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void BtnCancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Close();

        private static class NativeMethods
        {
            [System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")]
            public static extern int GetWindowLong(IntPtr hWnd, int nIndex);

            [System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll")]
            public static extern int SetWindowLong(IntPtr hWnd, int nIndex, int dwNewLong);
        }
    }
}

// Файл: MainWindow.xaml.cs

using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

        public MainWindow(int userId, int readerId, string fullName, List<string> roles, int userTypeId)
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            _currentUserId = userId;
            _currentReaderId = readerId;
            _currentUserTypeId = userTypeId;
            _currentUserFullName = fullName;
            _userRoles = roles ?? new List<string>();

            TbUserName.Text = fullName ?? "Пользователь";
            TbUserRole.Text = GetRoleDisplayName();
            SetupMenuVisibility();

            this.Loaded += Window_Loaded;
            this.SizeChanged += MainWindow_SizeChanged;
            MainFrame.Navigating += MainFrame_Navigating;
            MainFrame.LoadCompleted += MainFrame_LoadCompleted;
            MainFrame.NavigationFailed += MainFrame_NavigationFailed;
        }

        private async void Window_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            this.Loaded -= Window_Loaded;
            await OnWindowLoadedAsync();
        }

        // Вызови этот метод в OnWindowLoadedAsync после инициализации:
        private async Task OnWindowLoadedAsync()
        {
            if (_isInitialized) return;
            _isInitialized = true;

            try
            {
                await Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => LoadInitialPage());

                _ = Task.Run(() => InitializeNotificationServiceSync());
                _ = Task.Run(() => CheckAndHandleComputerSession());
                _ = Task.Run(() => StartReturnDateMonitoringBackground());
                _ = Task.Run(() => StartExpiredRequestsMonitoring());
                _ = Task.Run(async () => await ForceShowAllNotifications());
                await Task.Delay(2000);
                if (_notificationService != null)
                {
                    var count = _notificationService.GetUnreadCount();
                    UpdateUnreadCount(count);
                    System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"?? Первоначальный счетчик уведомлений: {count}");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"? Ошибка загрузки: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }
            
       
        /// <summary>
        /// Загрузка начальной страницы в зависимости от роли пользователя
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadInitialPage()
        {
            if (_userRoles.Contains("LIBRARIAN") || _userRoles.Contains("ADMIN"))
            {
                MainFrame.Navigate(new InformationServicePage());
            }
            else
            {
                MainFrame.Navigate(new RequestBook(_currentReaderId, _currentUserTypeId));
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Инициализация сервиса уведомлений в фоновом потоке
        /// </summary>
        private void InitializeNotificationServiceSync()
        {
            try
            {
                int notificationUserId = (_userRoles.Contains("LIBRARIAN") || _userRoles.Contains("ADMIN"))
                    ? _currentUserId
                    : _currentReaderId;

                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"?? Инициализация сервиса уведомлений для UserId: {notificationUserId}, Roles: {string.Join(", ", _userRoles)}");

                var notificationService = new NotificationService(
                    _connectionString,
                    Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher,
                    notificationUserId,
                    _currentUserTypeId,
                    _userRoles
                );

                notificationService.NewNotificationReceived += OnNewNotificationReceived;
                notificationService.UnreadCountChanged += OnUnreadCountChanged;
                notificationService.NotificationsUpdated += OnNotificationsUpdated;

                int intervalSeconds = (_userRoles.Contains("LIBRARIAN") || _userRoles.Contains("ADMIN")) ? 3 : 10;
                notificationService.StartPolling(intervalSeconds);

                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"? Сервис уведомлений инициализирован, интервал: {intervalSeconds} сек");

                Dispatcher.Invoke(() => _notificationService = notificationService);

                Task.Delay(1000).ContinueWith(_ =>
                {
                    _ = Task.Run(() => notificationService.CheckNewNotifications());
                    System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("?? Принудительная проверка уведомлений после инициализации");
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"?? Ошибка инициализации уведомлений: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обработчик обновления коллекции уведомлений
        /// </summary>
        private void OnNotificationsUpdated(object sender, ObservableCollection<NotificationService.NotificationItem> notifications)
        {
            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"?? ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ УВЕДОМЛЕНИЙ: получено {notifications.Count} уведомлений");
            foreach (var n in notifications)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"  - ID={n.ID_Notification}, Тип={n.NotificationType}, Сообщение={n.Message}");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Проверка и обработка активной сессии работы за ПК
        /// </summary>
        private void CheckAndHandleComputerSession()
        {
            bool isLibrarianOrAdmin = _userRoles.Contains("LIBRARIAN") || _userRoles.Contains("ADMIN");
            if (isLibrarianOrAdmin) return;

            try
            {
                var sessionService = new ComputerSessionService();
                var activeSessions = sessionService.GetActiveSessionsAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
                var existingSession = activeSessions.FirstOrDefault(s => s.UserID == _currentUserId);

                if (existingSession != null)
                {
                    _currentSessionId = existingSession.ID_Session;
                    return;
                }

                string groupCode = string.Empty;
                if (_currentUserTypeId == 1)
                {
                    using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                    {
                        conn.Open();
                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                            "SELECT ISNULL(g.GroupCode, '') FROM ReaderForm r LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID WHERE r.ReaderID = @ReaderId",
                            conn))
                        {
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", _currentReaderId);
                            var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                            groupCode = result != null ? result.ToString() : string.Empty;
                        }
                    }
                }

                Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                {
                    var computerWindow = new ComputerSessionWindow(_currentUserId, _currentReaderId, _currentUserFullName, groupCode);
                    computerWindow.Owner = this;
                    computerWindow.ShowDialog();
                });

                var updatedSessions = sessionService.GetActiveSessionsAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
                var newSession = updatedSessions.FirstOrDefault(s => s.UserID == _currentUserId);
                if (newSession != null) _currentSessionId = newSession.ID_Session;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("? Ошибка при работе с сессией ПК: " + ex.Message);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Запуск фонового мониторинга сроков возврата книг (каждые 24 часа)
        /// </summary>
        private void StartReturnDateMonitoringBackground()
        {
            try
            {
                System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(30000);
                CheckUpcomingReturnDatesSync();

                _returnDateTimer = new System.Threading.Timer(_ =>
                {
                    CheckUpcomingReturnDatesSync();
                }, null, TimeSpan.FromHours(24), TimeSpan.FromHours(24));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"?? Ошибка запуска мониторинга: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Проверка книг с приближающимся сроком возврата и отправка уведомлений
        /// Уведомления могут быть без привязки к заявке (RequestID = NULL)
        /// </summary>
        private void CheckUpcomingReturnDatesSync()
        {
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();

                    string query = @"
                        SELECT 
                            bi.IssuanceId,
                            bi.ReaderId,
                            bi.PlannedReturnDate,
                            b.TitleBook,
                            rf.ReaderID
                        FROM BookIssuance bi
                        INNER JOIN Books b ON bi.BookID = b.IDBook
                        LEFT JOIN ReaderForm rf ON bi.ReaderId = rf.ReaderID
                        WHERE 
                            bi.PlannedReturnDate BETWEEN CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND DATEADD(DAY, 3, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
                            AND bi.ReturnDate IS NULL
                            AND (bi.IsNotified IS NULL OR bi.IsNotified = 0)
                        ORDER BY bi.PlannedReturnDate";

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int issuanceId = reader.GetInt32(0);
                            int readerId = reader.GetInt32(1);
                            DateTime returnDate = reader.GetDateTime(2);
                            string bookTitle = reader.GetString(3);

                            int notificationTypeId;
                            using (var typeCmd = new SqlCommand("SELECT ID_Type FROM NotificationTypes WHERE TypeName = 'Скоро возврат'", conn))
                            {
                                var result = typeCmd.ExecuteScalar();
                                if (result == null)
                                {
                                    using (var insertTypeCmd = new SqlCommand(@"
                                        INSERT INTO NotificationTypes (TypeName, Description) 
                                        VALUES ('Скоро возврат', 'Уведомление о приближающемся сроке возврата');
                                        SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY();", conn))
                                    {
                                        notificationTypeId = Convert.ToInt32(insertTypeCmd.ExecuteScalar());
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    notificationTypeId = Convert.ToInt32(result);
                                }
                            }

                            string insertSql = @"
                                INSERT INTO RequestNotifications (RequestID, NotificationTypeID, Message, IsRead, CreatedDate)
                                VALUES (NULL, @NotificationTypeId, @Message, 0, GETDATE())";

                            using (var insertCmd = new SqlCommand(insertSql, conn))
                            {
                                insertCmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@NotificationTypeId", notificationTypeId);
                                insertCmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Message", $"? Уважаемый читатель! Книга '{bookTitle}' должна быть возвращена до {returnDate:dd.MM.yyyy}");
                                insertCmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                            }

                            string updateSql = "UPDATE BookIssuance SET IsNotified = 1 WHERE IssuanceId = @IssuanceId";
                            using (var updateCmd = new SqlCommand(updateSql, conn))
                            {
                                updateCmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@IssuanceId", issuanceId);
                                updateCmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                            }

                            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"? Отправлено уведомление о возврате книги '{bookTitle}' читателю {readerId}");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"? Ошибка проверки сроков возврата: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }
